But It Will Look Better Than $90 Brent Feels. Here Is the Interpretive Trap to Avoid With Your Portfolio. | | The July CPI arrives this morning at 8:30 a.m. ET, the most consequential inflation reading of the summer. Economists surveyed by Dow Jones expect 3.4% inflation on an annual basis, down from 3.5% in June, with core CPI expected to rise 0.2% month-over-month and ease to 2.5% year-over-year. This is the first CPI to carry the full Strait of Hormuz pass-through, and it lands with Brent having touched $90 on Tuesday for the first time this month. The central question: does energy’s renewed climb overwhelm the modest disinflation economists expect elsewhere? | | For your portfolio, there is a specific interpretive trap to avoid. The July CPI is a backward-looking average: gas prices fell early in July on optimism about the conflict, then rose again as fighting resumed, and on net Bank of America expects gas to show a 2–3% decline in the report. That is why the headline can ease to 3.4% even as spot oil sits at a monthly high — July’s average was still below June, while this week’s $90 Brent belongs to the August data not reported until September. For the American investor at or near retirement, a reassuring 3.4% headline this morning should not be read as “inflation is beaten,” but as “inflation eased in July before the August oil surge that has not yet been measured.” The forward energy risk is fully intact and will show up next month. # PRESS RELEASE

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
August 12, 2026

**CONTACT**
Todd Cheewing
Todd@Ascent-Strategic.com

**LILY TANG WILLIAMS: MAGGIE DOESN’T UNDERSTAND SOCIALISM — SHE JUST VOTES FOR IT**

WEARE, N.H. — Lily Tang Williams blasted Congresswoman Maggie Goodlander today after Goodlander said it was “not entirely clear” to her what Democratic socialists believe at a recent Rotary Club event. _See the RNC Research post here:_

[https://tinyurl.com/4m5v7p4b](https://us.list-manage.com/K4iTlx_x1fD?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c) “Growing up in China, as the eldest daughter in my family it was my job to stand in the food ration lines. That meant getting up at 5 AM in the dead of winter just to bring home a measly amount of flour for my family,” Williams said. She continued: “Yet, every day in the halls of our colleges or on cable tv or popular online streams, an alarming number of Americans and Granite Staters are calling to implement the sorts of political and economic regimes that starved my family and stripped me of my basic human dignity.” Therefore, Williams asserts: “Maggie can play coy and plead ignorance about what socialism is and what today’s socialists believe. After escaping China, I know exactly what happens when government gains more power over our lives — whether it’s less individual freedom, higher taxes, or higher prices for you for goods of less quality and quantity. I’ll fight this sort of overreach every single day in Congress.”

**About Lily Tang Williams**
Born in China just before Mao’s Cultural Revolution to working-class parents, Lily Tang Williams immigrated to the United States with nothing and built a life as an entrepreneur, educator, and community leader in Weare, NH. I have good news and bad news. I am going to start with the good, because I think you deserve to hear it. **July was the strongest grassroots fundraising month of this entire campaign.** While Sabato's Crystal Ball was moving 14 races toward Democrats. While James Talarico's billionaire backers were writing $10 million checks. While the national environment was shifting against Republicans at every turn, Texas conservatives showed up in a way that I will never forget. You gave more in July than in any month since this campaign began. Not because a single mega-donor wrote a massive check. Because thousands of grassroots conservatives across this state and this country decided that Texas was worth fighting for. That is the good news. And it is genuinely great news. **Now here is the bad news.** **Fox News just released a new poll showing James Talarico leading me 51% to 48%. This is Fox News. Not a Democratic pollster. Not a liberal outlet._Fox News_. And their poll shows Talarico over 50% for the first time in this race.** Here is what the numbers show. Talarico has 98% of Democrats. He has 68% of independents. And 24% of non-MAGA Republicans are supporting him. That last number is the one that concerns me most. Nearly one in four Republicans who did not back President Trump is currently planning to vote for a Democrat who believes God is nonbinary, calls the American flag a complicated symbol, and wants a welcome mat at the southern border. **_I am not going to sugarcoat this. These numbers are serious._** But here is what I know. The margin of error on the Fox News poll is plus or minus 3 points. This race is not over. Among undecided voters, more lean toward me than toward Talarico. And the grassroots momentum we built in July proves that when conservatives show up, we can compete. The question is whether we can keep that momentum going into August... James Talarico has raised $70 million. He has the national media telling the story he wants told. **What I have is you, and the strongest grassroots month this campaign has ever seen.** Let us make August even stronger. clean_body: I have good news and bad news... I have good news and bad news... | | | | | | | Peter, I have good news and bad news. I am going to start with the good, because I think you deserve to hear it. July was the strongest grassroots fundraising month of this entire campaign. While Sabato's Crystal Ball was moving 14 races toward Democrats. While James Talarico's billionaire backers were writing $10 million checks. While the national environment was shifting against Republicans at every turn, Texas conservatives showed up in a way that I will never forget. You gave more in July than in any month since this campaign began. Not because a single mega-donor wrote a massive check. Because thousands of grassroots conservatives across this state and this country decided that Texas was worth fighting for. That is the good news. And it is genuinely great news. Now here is the bad news. Fox News just released a new poll showing James Talarico leading me 51% to 48%. This is Fox News. Not a Democratic pollster. Not a liberal outlet.Fox News. And their poll shows Talarico over 50% for the first time in this race. Here is what the numbers show. Talarico has 98% of Democrats. He has 68% of independents. And 24% of non-MAGA Republicans are supporting him. That last number is the one that concerns me most. Nearly one in four Republicans who did not back President Trump is currently planning to vote for a Democrat who believes God is nonbinary, calls the American flag a complicated symbol, and wants a welcome mat at the southern border. I am not going to sugarcoat this. These numbers are serious. But here is what I know. The margin of error on the Fox News poll is plus or minus 3 points. This race is not over. Among undecided voters, more lean toward me than toward Talarico. And the grassroots momentum we built in July proves that when conservatives show up, we can compete. The question is whether we can keep that momentum going into August... James Talarico has raised $70 million. He has the national media telling the story he wants told. What I have is you, and the strongest grassroots month this campaign has ever seen. Let us make August even stronger. Thank you, Ken Paxton P.S. -- Fox News showed Talarico at 51%. We have no time to coast in August. Please give right now and help us close the gap in August. () | | | Paid for by Ken Paxton for Senate | | PO BOX 3476 MCKINNEY, TX 75070 | | |

| | | | | [](https://jseax8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XKyp4SMfKpUl5cmtCJX3mKN1Oq2Q-_N34rD_yLeEwEJ4qBp7rRPcuiL6MBiWG4ORBwTIGN-drr5ubUHBdRJA7c6rOl5b6DB6NnLDBg0uFS0T9dtNtFZh_e7mRm4HAuO7Ibt9MdKKYvRWkzr1hPKldHuobyPJPXgdOKMqKheLOxpw-e8grhkxQC97X_P-CkUdy9sNBx-c6j5MIhd2kCyUN1F53Z2wY1H-&c=j5LObGr5vkQpod4G6UM2F3GcyBkufyg21MQjKZaRf7Ez4O6JPU4v6Q==&ch=incDDSej22S24T6dGvTTZFmHZOKO-r-3B6hFQIPC-wcnX42wBKTZeg==)

Peter,
I've said it before and I'll say it again: Mike Johnson is the Antichrist. You can't claim to be a Christian and in the same breath cut trillions of dollars out of Medicaid and SNAP.
---
| [](https://jseax8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XKyp4SMfKpUl5cmtCJX3mKN1Oq2Q-_N34rD_yLeEwEJ4qBp7rRPcuiL6MBiWG4ORBwTIGN-drr5ubUHBdRJA7c6rOl5b6DB6NnLDBg0uFS0T9dtNtFZh_e7mRm4HAuO7Ibt9MdKKYvRWkzr1hPKldHuobyPJPXgdOKMqKheLOxpw-e8grhkxQC97X_P-CkUdy9sNBx-c6j4Z7CC5wu93QDv7a2YBEoMP&c=j5LObGr5vkQpod4G6UM2F3GcyBkufyg21MQjKZaRf7Ez4O6JPU4v6Q==&ch=incDDSej22S24T6dGvTTZFmHZOKO-r-3B6hFQIPC-wcnX42wBKTZeg==)

Mike Johnson says his Christian faith is the foundation of his career and his life. His actions don't match his words.
As Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson has had every opportunity to uphold the preachings of the gospel that was preached to me on Sunday mornings: we should love our neighbor and treat them as our own. Instead of using his faith, he gave us falsehoods and fraudulence.
Let's pull up the receipts:

* Mike Johnson refused to extend subsidies that would have kept healthcare costs low for families and voted to gut Medicaid.

* Mike Johnson voted to cut Social Security which would make it hard for your grandparents to buy food or life-saving medicine.

* Mike Johnson voted against same-sex marriage and wrote the "don't say LGBTQ" bill in 2022 that would have affected public libraries, public schools, and military bases, and hospitals.

* Mike Johnson played a key role in trying to overturn the 2020 election.

That's just a drop in the bucket when it comes to Mike Johnson's long history of hypocrisy. In each instance, he's used his Christian faith to explain his actions every step of the way.

body:
We noticed this quote from Jamie Raskin that was worth sharing.
#

Friends –
In a new letter to the ATF Director, House Democrats are sounding the alarm about the Trump Administration’s proposal to gut our progress on gun safety.
We noticed this quote from Congressman Jamie Raskin that was worth sharing.
| | | | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
Taken together, these proposals constitute the most sweeping effort in decades to weaken federal firearms safeguards, prevent accountability within the firearms industry, limit law enforcement’s oversight of firearms dealers, and make it easier for dangerous individuals to obtain dangerous weapons...

**We urge ATF to immediately withdraw these dangerous proposals.** Jamie Raskin |
An overwhelming majority of Americans support efforts to keep our communities safe from gun violence. These proposals from the ATF would make that much, much more difficult.
If the Trump Administration acts to weaken our gun safety laws, then we need to spring into action. Because very few Americans want that.
[**If you understand why our work to organize, educate, and persuade people about gun safety is so important to saving lives, please make a contribution of $10 or more to GIFFORDS PAC today. Hi Peter,
The primary is over, and now we’re officially in the sprint to the general election on November 3rd!
First, I want to take a moment to say thank you – for showing up, for chipping in, for knocking doors, and for every conversation you've had with a friend or neighbor about what's at stake this year. Your support has meant so much, and I’m grateful to know you’re by my side in the fight ahead.
Now, we really get to work over the next 83 days. This is one of the most consequential fights of our lifetimes, and what we do right now will determine whether we deliver a blue wave and the direction of our country for years to come.
I want to take a moment to remember what we're fighting for, because this administration is counting on us to lose sight of it.
A safer, more affordable, and more just America. Access to quality healthcare. An economy that works for all of us – not just the rich and powerful. An immigration system grounded in safety, dignity, and justice. Leaders who put people over profits.
If we win in November, we can protect women's bodily autonomy and their right to access safe, science-backed reproductive care. We can push back on RFK Jr.'s dangerous misinformation and defend evidence-based public health. We can address Trump's affordability crisis and deliver real relief for working families. We can defend our democracy and the constitutional checks and balances this administration has spent the 18 months trying to dismantle.
We can do it all if we put in the work right now.
I'm going to spend every one of these 83 days doing what I've always done: knocking doors, listening to constituents, and fighting back. The road to the House majority requires that we hold MN-03, so let’s make sure we do!

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Fellow Conservative,

If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources,
https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NjZ9AAwAAAAAAk1PhBJ8XRAXCToxEvscP8w3y0fE22gF7Gm3vM4wrxHLROURez1ygNlTzEbotFA_NtyUtM4n5BLr27aPGyPoTWdrVPYxY3rHMerYp-fWBg
please let me tell you why it’s so critical.

Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.

She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the Three Musketeers, Treasure Island and Charlotte’s Web.

But today, all that has changed.

Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’

Radical librarians call Adventures of Huckleberry Finn and To Kill a Mockingbird “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ Little House series.

And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages...

A is for Activist. An ABCboardbook for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.”

Woke Baby. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.”

Prince and Knight. The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess.

And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”

I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NjZ9AAwAAAAAAk1PhBJ9Q7jEDBCxXjFieBwv99S-9Qi27dNdk2d6KlwpVlZ9HvlQA_CqflXAvvq5upUJt4St_geXjeex_FFXRd76WAf9GpPzzPrEm2C3Rw

...but that’s just not true.

<- THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour.”

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NjZ9AAwAAAAAAk1PhBJ-NUyRixpzy1Jpsm0P-ZU-5BCQpxI762uGb7Cjcr-f0qwDSWtNE4nyDJjYIqtKKWCTxySqRZUlAXxajqXoMR9Le-LhvL5hCTzQmg
That’s why parents and grandparents across the country are rising up through See You At The Library Day.

For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.

And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.

Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion.

Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.

The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: Rick about a cross-dressing Grandpa, Melissa filled with graphic nudity, and Darkstalker featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.

But here’s what’s really alarming.

We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”

That may be good for your family -- for now.

But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NjZ9AAwAAAAAAk1PhBJ_VSf-4sGccd-ceZfVn9zduLh4HdfxeVE1RtsfrKEvyEOjaDczR85QqP4flv6iFwCxQSjePyyD2FcBE7t9C5EC0yzChcDSFuLKgg
I hope you see why I need your help today.

My name is Kirk Cameron.

Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”

I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.

But the gospel saved me.

I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.

When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.

So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.

Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with conservative Story Hours filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.

And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one

bit.

>> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.

>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves.

But a neighbor learned about Daniel's plans and reported him to the mayor, demanding that the city "put a stop to this." Shockingly, University Heights, Ohio did exactly that. clean_body: This is one of those stories that sounds too outrageous to be real. Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this | | | | Friend, This is one of those stories that sounds too outrageous to be real. It's the story of a modern-day Daniel--the kind of story you'd expect to read about in history books, not the news. Daniel Grand is an Orthodox Jew. As a faithful practitioner of his faith, he simply wanted to host a small prayer gathering in his home with about a dozen friends. But a neighbor learned about Daniel's plans and reported him to the mayor, demanding that the city "put a stop to this." Shockingly, University Heights, Ohio did exactly that. City officials ordered Daniel to obtain a permit to hold the prayer gathering in his home, classifying it as a "place of religious assembly." Then things got worse. To make sure Daniel didn't hold prayer meetings without the permit, the city began surveilling his home and even encouraged neighbors to spy on him and report any suspected violations. Daniel tried to comply. But there was an impossible catch. The permit process wasn't designed for a family home--it was designed for churches, synagogues, and other dedicated houses of worship. If he successfully obtained the permit, Daniel and his family would have to stop living in their own house. In other words, the city presented him with an impossible choice: abandon his proposed prayer meetings or give up his house. And when Daniel filed a lawsuit seeking to rectify this violation of this free-exercise rights, the federal courts told him he needed to complete the permitting process first. Imagine being told that opening your home to prayer--something people of faith have done for centuries--now makes you a target of your own government. Imagine your neighbors watching your house, ready to report you. Daniel shouldn't have to face it alone. And he doesn't have to. Alliance Defending Freedom and co-counsel Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe are representing Daniel at the U.S. Supreme Court. Alliance Defending Freedom will never bill its clients for their defense. That's our commitment. But defending religious freedom against government overreach takes significant resources, and we can only do it because faithful supporters like you make it possible. That's why I'm reaching out today--and why your gift right now matters as much as ever. Thanks to a generous matching grant, every dollar you give will be doubled, while matching funds last. name: Peggy Flanagan
subject: In almost 250 years, there’s never been a Native woman serving in the US Senate.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
[](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260812-1-ak.k7OeV1&amount=10&refcode=em20260812-2908&t=2&akid=2908%2E251025%2E14dlRR)
Peter, in almost 250 years, there’s never been a Native woman serving in the US Senate. **It’s time to change that.**
I’m Peggy Flanagan, the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Minnesota.
I am Ojibwe and a proud member of the White Earth Nation. My family is the Wolf Clan. The mission of my clan is to never leave anyone behind — and that’s been my guiding principle.
I am the descendant of people who were forced off their land onto the White Earth reservation. I am the relative of residential boarding school survivors. I am the daughter of a man who always spoke truth to power for the good of the Anishinaabe people.
I’m thinking of my daughter — who just got her first jingle dress — and whether or not she will see Indigenous women in all parts of our government.
**Right now, there are _no_ Native voices in the US Senate. _If I win this race, we can change that._**
[**It's high time that all our communities have a seat at the table. If you agree, will you pitch in $10 or whatever you can to power my campaign and Abdul El-Sayed’s and help me make history?**](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260812-1-ak.k7OeV1&amount=10&refcode=em20260812-2908&t=3&akid=2908%2E251025%2E14dlRR)
**[Donate $10 ››](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260812-1-ak.k7OeV1&amount=10&refcode=em20260812-2908&t=4&akid=2908%2E251025%2E14dlRR)**
Too often, Native voices are ignored or erased in the halls of power.
That’s how we get awful so-called leaders like Donald Trump and J.D. Vance, who called Indigenous Peoples' Day a “fake holiday” and said that Native land was “enemy territory.”
My Ojibwe name means 'Speaks in a Loud and Clear Voice woman.' So I’m using that voice to call out MAGA extremism — loudly and clearly.
But I can’t do it alone. I need your help to build a campaign strong enough to cut through the noise. [**That’s why I’m personally asking, Peter, will you pitch in a split gift to my campaign to help us make history?**](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260812-1-ak.k7OeV1&amount=10&refcode=em20260812-2908&t=5&akid=2908%2E251025%2E14dlRR)

Chi miigwech (that’s Ojibwe big thank you) for being part of this hopeful movement.
Peggy

And I can’t thank you enough for sticking by my side throughout this race and everything Minnesota has gone through over the last year. The support of everyone on this team and in this incredible, nationwide movement helped us stay organized and make this victory possible.
**Last night Minnesota sent a clear message:** We are sick and tired of the status quo, sick and tired of MAGA fascism, sick and tired of billionaire oligarchy, and we’re ready to fight back.
Despite the establishment’s constant pushback, our ideas — Medicare-for-All, universal childcare, abolishing ICE, ending endless wars, cutting off aid for Israel’s genocide — are becoming more popular by the day.
That's because the American people are struggling as the cost of living skyrockets, and wondering why only the rich get richer. They are seeing billions be spent on war and genocide abroad and wondering why that money isn’t spent here at home. They are seeing ICE violence and brutality and wondering why we can’t have a chaos-free and humane immigration system.
**Our movement has a simple, common-sense vision of the future that is winning in every corner of this nation. A future where everyone has what they need, every one of our neighbors is taken care of, and everyone gets the dignity, respect, and affordable life they deserve.**
So, we may have won this race for the nomination, but the fight is far from over.
I’m going to spend the next three months working tirelessly to rally progressive voters in Minnesota as well as states and districts across the country to make sure we take back the majority in Congress and provide a real check on Trump’s power. We have an exciting and historic slate of candidates to elect, and with your help we will usher in the most progressive Congress this country has ever seen.
[**If you’re ready to continue this important fight, use this link or the button below to make your first contribution.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-aug26.wDIP7w&refcode=em260812-1-subs&t=3&akid=2435%2E791427%2E5UozxE)
So, thank you again, to everyone who believes in me and this movement. Let’s take a moment to celebrate, reflect, and gather our strength. Then let’s hit the ground running for our democracy, our neighbors, and our future.
Thank you, and in solidarity,
Rep. Ilhan Omar

name: Peggy Flanagan
subject: I’m used to being the underdog
body:
I’m no stranger to being underestimated.

It’s Peggy Flanagan, the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Minnesota.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260812_2.rif5lP&refcode=em20260812-2&t=1001&akid=8261%2E582294%2EM5kOaJ ]Young Peggy Flanagan

As a child with severe chronic asthma, I was constantly told what I
wouldn’t be able to do. And I proved them wrong.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260812_2.rif5lP&refcode=em20260812-2&t=1002&akid=8261%2E582294%2EM5kOaJ ]Peggy Flanagan with supporters

When I first ran for school board in 2004, I was up against a crowded
field — including two incumbents — and people told me I had no chance of
winning. I became the youngest person to be elected to the Minneapolis
Board of Education and won the most votes. I proved the doubters wrong.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260812_2.rif5lP&refcode=em20260812-2&t=1003&akid=8261%2E582294%2EM5kOaJ ]Peggy Flanagan taking the oath of office

In 2015, I became only the second Native American woman in the Minnesota
House when I won my special election and proved the doubters wrong.

So now, when I hear folks say we can’t compete with the avalanche of GOP
cash coming our way I know that we will do what we always do, we’re going
to prove the doubters wrong, again.

There will always be doubters, but I’ve always chosen not to listen. I
keep my head down, get the work done, and deliver for the people of
Minnesota.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260812_2.rif5lP&refcode=em20260812-2&t=1004&akid=8261%2E582294%2EM5kOaJ ]That’s exactly what I’ll do on the Senate floor. Can you split a $10
donation between Chris Pappas and I now to help us make history again?

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260812_2.rif5lP&amount=5&refcode=em20260812-2&t=1023&akid=8261%2E582294%2EM5kOaJ ]Donate $5 »

This campaign isn’t about me — it’s about all of us, working together to
defeat extremist billionaires and make sure Minnesotans have a voice in
the U.S. Senate.

That’s why I refuse to take a cent of corporate PAC money. Every dollar we
raise comes from people like you, giving a little bit at a time.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260812_2.rif5lP&refcode=em20260812-2&t=1024&akid=8261%2E582294%2EM5kOaJ ]I’m used to being the underdog, and I’m not backing down from this
fight — but Chris Pappas and I need people like you standing in my corner.
A lot of folks say they’re building a different kind of campaign, but we
really are and every penny counts. Please help us out with a split gift
today.

Thank you for everything!

💚 Peggy

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.chrispappas.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=8261%2E582294%2EM5kOaJ

Peter, Tyler's message absolutely broke my heart, and I'd like you to read it if you have a moment:
My name is Tyler Tew. I was a commercial airline pilot for 14 years. I flew for SkyWest as a Captain and then Allegiant. I graduated from Utah State with an aviation degree and built my entire life around flying. I went to Washington on January 6 after being invited by friends.

**ICYMI: Warmington Claims She Was Duped into Lobbying for Opioid Industry **
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** August 12th, 2026
---
| | | **CONTACT** karina@nhrsc.com

---
| |

**CONCORD, NH —** In today’s [_Union Leader_](https://us.list-manage.com/14Dqxp9HAHl?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=QkOjCdS9ygcjjAIofhLOmdmqkrDfpsRDSzCUNf8PzMU8AYl3mhdoyfUQBQ==) , Opioid Lobbyist Cinde Warmington claims she was duped into lobbying for Purdue Pharma, her latest excuse for her disqualifying record. But the story makes clear her pattern of putting her own self-interest over Granite Staters continued for more than a decade.
“Opioid Lobbyist Cinde Warmington continues to make excuses because she knows she can’t defend her disqualifying record,” **said NHRSC Chairman Scott Maltzie**. “The spin doesn’t change the facts: Opioid Lobbyist Cinde Warmington chose her own self-interest over Granite State families, and voters won’t forget it in November.”
In the same article where Warmington is claiming she was duped into being an opioid lobbyist, reporter Kevin Landrigan notes that at the very same legislative hearing where Opioid Lobbyist Warmington called OxyContin a “miracle drug” with “very few side effects”, then-DHHS Commissioner Donald Shumway was already warning lawmakers that the drug was “highly addictive”. The reporting also notes that for more than a decade, Warmington represented Michael O’Connell’s PainCare network, helping negotiate a settlement tied to a kickback scandal, and lobbying against legislation that would have prevented disgraced doctors with revoked medical licenses from owning medical practices. In return for her advocacy, Warmington received nearly $50,000 in campaign funding from these bad actors.

MDOT contract for storm debris cleanup grows to $2.88 million (https://mississippiwire.news/article.html?slug=mdot-contract-for-storm-debris-cleanup-grows-to-2-88-million)
The Mississippi Transportation Commission approved a $2.1 million increase to a debris-monitoring contract tied to Winter Storm Fern cleanup during its Aug. 12 meeting in Jackson.
Continue reading → (https://mississippiwire.news/article.html?slug=mdot-contract-for-storm-debris-cleanup-grows-to-2-88-million)
Auditor's Report Shows Attorney General Recovered Little of DHS Demands (https://mississippiwire.news/article.html?slug=auditor-s-report-shows-attorney-general-recovered-little-of-dhs-demands)
Mississippi's Office of the State Auditor recovered more than $1 million in taxpayer funds in Fiscal Year 2026, but its annual report shows the Attorney General's office has enforced only a fraction of the tens of millions still owed to the state.
Read → (https://mississippiwire.news/article.html?slug=auditor-s-report-shows-attorney-general-recovered-little-of-dhs-demands)

Governor Tate Reeves has appointed Columbia attorney Renee McBride Porter as chancellor of the 10th Chancery Court District, filling the vacancy created by the retirement of Judge Chase Ford Morgan.
Read → (https://mississippiwire.news/article.html?slug=reeves-appoints-renee-mcbride-porter-chancellor-for-10th-chancery-court-district)
34 School Superintendents Make More Than the Governor of Mississippi (https://mississippiwire.news/article.html?slug=34-school-superintendents-make-more-than-the-governor-of-mississippi)
The Governor of Mississippi is paid $160,000 a year. At least 34 school district superintendents make more than that.
Read → (https://mississippiwire.news/article.html?slug=34-school-superintendents-make-more-than-the-governor-of-mississippi)

Wire and cable maker Southwire will add about 380,000 square feet to its Starkville plant in an expansion of more than $256 million that creates 128 jobs, with full capacity expected in 2028.

County School District budget request said to exceed state cap RANKIN COUNTY — The county board's attorney told supervisors the district's funding request appears to violate a state law limiting annual increases to 7 percent. subject: Reaching out about Nacogdoches County
body:
We’re fighting for all 254 Texas counties — let’s make sure no voter is left behind.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
**We’re announcing something big today: Our statewide 254 County General Election Mobilization Plan.**
As I’ve traveled across Texas meeting with families, small business owners, teachers, and students, one thing is clear: Texans are ready for bold, new leadership who will show up and truly fight for them every day.
And here’s the truth: Competing in Texas means showing up everywhere. Not just the biggest cities, or where the battleground will be easier. All 254 counties — **that’s how we win this.**
**Right now, I’m polling within 1 point of Greg Abbott.** That means victory is not only possible, but it’s well within reach. But we have to do the work to win this.
That’s why we are assigning each of our supporters to a specific county in Texas where we need to mobilize voters. **You’ve been assigned Nacogdoches County, where more than 39,731 Texans are registered to vote. We’ve set a goal of raising $6,000 to support our efforts in Nacogdoches County — and we need your help to get there.**
**[I’ll say more, but first, can you rush a donation of $5 to help us reach voters in Nacogdoches County?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260812_1_adopt.Ti3isS&amount=5&refcode=em20260812-1810&t=1&akid=1810%2E299639%2EeK1HmM)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260812_1_adopt.Ti3isS&amount=5&refcode=em20260812-1810&t=3&akid=1810%2E299639%2EeK1HmM)
For too long, politicians have written off entire counties they think are too small or too far. **This campaign is different. We’re working to organize all across Texas.**
To reach every single voter, we need the resources to make sure we can mobilize voters to knock on doors, make calls, hang signs, run ads — anything we can to get out the vote on Election Day.
**_Here’s how you can help us win:_** In Nacogdoches County, there are more than 39,731 registered voters. That means we need to raise $6,000 to reach every voter in Nacogdoches County between now and November. **Can I count on you to adopt Nacogdoches County to help us reach every single voter and win in November?** ➡️ [**Yes! I’ll sponsor Nacogdoches County.**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260812_1_adopt.Ti3isS&amount=5&refcode=em20260812-1810-sponsor&t=4&akid=1810%2E299639%2EeK1HmM) ➡️ [**No, but I’ll volunteer to help reach voters in Nacogdoches County.**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/2202?refcode=em20260812-1810-vol&t=5&akid=1810%2E299639%2EeK1HmM) [Support Nacogdoches County »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260812_1_adopt.Ti3isS&amount=5&refcode=em20260812-1810-box&t=6&akid=1810%2E299639%2EeK1HmM)
---
Your support isn’t just about winning, it’s about making sure every Texan has a voice and a leader who will put up a fight. And every voter we reach could make a difference in defeating Greg Abbott and taking back Texas from the far right.
**[So, Peter, can you chip in $5 today to make sure all 254 counties have a chance to be heard between now and November?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260812_1_adopt.Ti3isS&amount=5&refcode=em20260812-1810&t=7&akid=1810%2E299639%2EeK1HmM)**

Let’s show up for Texas together.
Thank you,
Team Gina

body:

| |

# 6 Days to Determine Our Children's Future.
Dear friend, The current "administration" is absent. Absent from building the Key Bridge; from accepting the federal education scholarships of $1700 per student for our most needy students; from helping the disabled community and instead taking $300 million out of DDA (including the matching fund); from negotiating to keep our beloved Preakness leg of the Triple Crown - instead, wasting the $600 million in taxpayer dollars used to buy Maryland horse racing.

_And absent from helping the nearly 300,000 residents being cut off from their electric right now - more than three times last year's number - because of outrageous electric bill increases_ ; it is this Moore administration's failed government policies alone that are harming our State.

All while they are actively seeking a constitutional amendment to steal the last voice in Congress of Republicans by permanently arrogating to the Legislature and Governor the power to gerrymander.

We are streaming TV ads to 556 channels to a targeted swing vote reaching thousands of Marylanders every day. But we want to have even more commercials and views.

If you want to see more TV ads all over our State like we do, then we need your immediate help. For those who have or are already helping, we are so grateful. We are still about $300,000 behind our goal.

We only have six days until the first financial report cut-off on August 18. If you want to help us win, and if you want a Maryland we can live, work and retire in, now is the time to donate. Here is a list of expenses we would like to cover:
* TV ads: $6000/week (15 donors a week at [$400 each weekly](https://us.list-manage.com/9l6KN0iE104?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)).
* Billboards across the state: $25,000 ([100 donors at $250](https://us.list-manage.com/11CbmqOzawk?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b))
* Direct Mail: $160,000 to reach 320,000 voters ([400 donors at $400 each](https://us.list-manage.com/7UCZYqPR6eH?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b))

Please become part of our Maryland 400 program where you celebrate our Founding and the 250th Anniversary of our Nation with your generous support of [$400. Or any amount.](https://us.list-manage.com/Rs8yiE4w5RS?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) Thank you.

For Maryland,

Dan Cox
Republican Nominee for Governor of Maryland

He is celebrating today, thinking his seat is safe and his corporate donors are happy. But here is what Pete Stauber doesn't realize: the general election is going to be a completely different ballgame, and we are putting a massive target directly on his back. [**Before we go on, can we count on you to help the warchest that will hold him accountable for selling out the Boundary Waters by rushing a $25 donation today?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/VmFFfvoaaBGjTwBgwZNenw~~/AAUS1hA~/IOCupSJOoiNx30stwblcWRUqhCh48SccRoGPDZNx0u6mR5f-U-wmrJ-53mOf60y0BlfG4v1tl75D05RYLGR4oe0Cry0nJgaPKaPDvvOOk0tkIHkZ5VkUDI2wSCDoStDz2uE9o29kVjwySMCIT-ounaQqou10fLytNgIax6dLOL8wcK-WZA4k06E_Lg8olLjEnSJfAhcR690F54Lh93uDijXA8oSZRz1xofIyEveAkk4LfT7nvWF80Zpx-_gK2RZ8) Earlier this year, Stauber authored and pushed through a disastrous piece of legislation—using an unprecedented, backdoor procedural trick—to overturn a 20-year ban on toxic sulfide-ore copper mining in the Superior National Forest. **His goal was to hand the keys to the headwaters of the most-visited wilderness area in the country directly to Antofagasta, a Chilean mining conglomerate.** Because of Pete Stauber, a foreign corporation now has a green light to build a toxic mine that threatens the clean water, wildlife, and 17,000 local jobs that rely on the pristine Boundary Waters. And that isn’t some “pie in the sky” fantasy.
Just four years ago, the fair maps movement helped deliver what _The New York Times_ called “the fairest House map of the last 40 years” — after years of organizing, advocacy, electoral wins, and litigation.
But Donald Trump got Republicans to erase those gains with an onslaught of mid-decade gerrymanders, all so they could give themselves an artificial advantage. clean_body: Republicans are trying to win by cheating. | This headline says it all, Peter: | = But only one of those things is supposed to matter in a democracy: the will of the people. If more Americans vote for Democrats, Democrats should hold more power. But Republicans have rammed through so many extreme gerrymanders in the past year that they are trying to cling to control of the House, no matter what the voters have to say. That is a violation of democracy. This year, we need to elect fair maps champions who will help end the redistricting crisis. But we can’t stop there. We must also level the playing field by putting an end to gerrymandering once and for all. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = Elections should come down to which candidates earn more votes, not which parties draw more district lines. And that isn’t some “pie in the sky” fantasy. Just four years ago, the fair maps movement helped deliver what The New York Times called “the fairest House map of the last 40 years” — after years of organizing, advocacy, electoral wins, and litigation. But Donald Trump got Republicans to erase those gains with an onslaught of mid-decade gerrymanders, all so they could give themselves an artificial advantage. That's the pattern. Block first. Cave only when the pressure gets too heavy to ignore.

**Now it 's our turn to apply the pressure that removes her from office entirely.**

| MassGOP Chair's Update
---
---
| My Fellow Republicans, The Massachusetts Republican Party has been busy all Summer long, and July has been an especially active month. We are fighting hard to strengthen our political finance operations, expand our communications reach, and build real momentum for Republican candidates across the Commonwealth. A heartfelt shout-out goes to our dedicated town committee members, grassroots activists, and hardworking interns whose energy and commitment on the ground are driving these efforts forward every day. Together, we are ensuring our message of fiscal responsibility and accountability continues to resonate with Massachusetts taxpayers as we head into a critical election season.
---
| Action Items:
Let's get down to business with some of the most timely actions items we have for the 2026 Election Cycle.
Sign Locations Update - Quick data update: we're seeing so much success securing high-value sign locations that I had to share. We can now identify the best sign locations in a district using MassDOT traffic data matched with voter data. Signs don't vote, but they do help build name ID, and our candidates are seeing great results using targeted texts to these voters to secure placements. If you have a candidate who could benefit from this tool, reach out to [Aidan@MassGOP.com](mailto:Aidan@MassGOP.com) and he can walk through the details.
Ballot Questions Guide - With so many ballot questions on the ballot this year, the Massachusetts Republican Party has prepared this clear guide outlining our positions and voting recommendations. Because the wording of some questions can be confusing, and because Attorney General Andrea Campbell's office made a questionable decision that removed a widely popular tax reduction measure from the ballot; we want to make sure voters have straightforward, reliable information. Click here for the full guide.
---
|
---
Call for fall interns - The Massachusetts Republican Party is seeking motivated and detail-oriented Interns to assist our team in the lead-up to the 2026 election cycle. As a MassGOP Intern, you'll get a behind-the-scenes look at Party operations. Every day will look a little different, but you'll gain valuable experience in areas like campaign operations, communications, and finance.
---

MassGOP is always looking for ways to expand what we can offer while making every dollar work harder. Here are two great examples.
Web Pages - We can now build campaign and RTC/RCC websites in-house. Rep. DeCoste's website is a great example of what we're able to produce. It's another resource we're putting in the hands of our candidates and organizers to help them run stronger, more professional campaigns without breaking the bank. [https://citizensfordecoste.com/](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001m9ULHWyLBN2f1CqO7EZQOD43TYspU5KdImZsVttNScvgB3R4OTFSvzfMYLqbEHjhhHJT7REs_Qut4QYAQ6K9mbMnpLpljR5At8GFOpQCCsVmLP4f2DPuTlBX2ZTBhO1kCPe3ULjg8K0mm3fc0mgEqbJEDymx5kPb&c=Hgkk4svz7a-fk7XpozYxKKoDpsSN33wMzYB2TRvrb932g2SK_FTwrQ==&ch=FclcBI0yqRbSOBtzoQXHCiQjXhHr0SwlaJY2jCT-IqWQXbosM90oWw==)
Relational Texting Free Through Numinar - In Numinar's relational texting for campaigns, supporters sync their personal contacts with the voter file; the system matches them to targets and supplies approved scripts, then the supporters send the texts directly from their own phones to friends and family so the messages appear as personal texts rather than campaign blasts, while Numinar still tracks the outreach without routing it through the main bulk texting system. Think, Dear Friend Cards, modernized to texting!
Every cycle we find new ways to do more. From our expanded data program and voter targeting to texting, door-knocking, social media, and now campaign websites, we're continuing to raise the bar and give our candidates and local leaders the resources that simply weren't available before.

clean_body: | | | | | | | == | MassGOP Chair's Update | My Fellow Republicans, The Massachusetts Republican Party has been busy all Summer long, and July has been an especially active month. We are fighting hard to strengthen our political finance operations, expand our communications reach, and build real momentum for Republican candidates across the Commonwealth. A heartfelt shout-out goes to our dedicated town committee members, grassroots activists, and hardworking interns whose energy and commitment on the ground are driving these efforts forward every day. Together, we are ensuring our message of fiscal responsibility and accountability continues to resonate with Massachusetts taxpayers as we head into a critical election season. | Action Items: Let's get down to business with some of the most timely actions items we have for the 2026 Election Cycle. Sign Locations Update - Quick data update: we're seeing so much success securing high-value sign locations that I had to share. We can now identify the best sign locations in a district using MassDOT traffic data matched with voter data. Signs don't vote, but they do help build name ID, and our candidates are seeing great results using targeted texts to these voters to secure placements. If you have a candidate who could benefit from this tool, reach out to mailto:Aidan@MassGOP.com and he can walk through the details. Ballot Questions Guide - With so many ballot questions on the ballot this year, the Massachusetts Republican Party has prepared this clear guide outlining our positions and voting recommendations. Because the wording of some questions can be confusing, and because Attorney General Andrea Campbell's office made a questionable decision that removed a widely popular tax reduction measure from the ballot; we want to make sure voters have straightforward, reliable information. Click here for the full guide. | Call for fall interns - The Massachusetts Republican Party is seeking motivated and detail-oriented Interns to assist our team in the lead-up to the 2026 election cycle. Here are two great examples. Web Pages - We can now build campaign and RTC/RCC websites in-house. Rep. DeCoste's website is a great example of what we're able to produce. Patriot, I went back and forth on if I should send you this or not. Not because I didn't know what to say, but because I knew how much it would hurt to say it. It’s difficult to admit that I can't do this alone. [**There's so much weighing on me right now, and finding the right words feels impossible. But I'm trusting these words will reach you the way they need to.**](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6zvdjLjeZKIt1tT_uPEbTC36rMTx9_3aQXl0V7RHkScmh_R9CV_jqBYQ8UksEF5uOpSQRI9hLbPM1qu0YnoUPzkfovtvmRb1krK7SZykmNRY5bzILObOlsWPpuwAD5oO753vXFnlZG0aI443-etIIsB6PgW68Fvggr_Ww0eSlRqZygdtoRgcWn3fgUSgRJkowe-Ubty581n71sHhP0y7MXiYKxFtsLCFh6_U2Ci_2WCn0Ai5foo4j_evv8CzFj5CVEAIH25Og4Gq24KW8zTXzn8__K3zT6CfzWe_TWNXwd8R9B38Q5Ksxk4tsoAany8eJ3oRW9ym1z4FdA66-gkgyQBrUHVT-dE9ESPNDSfgmXpTMMHME1TTdm7J395yqcKzxw/4t4/BVeNr2O2Q8GWzjsfFup4lQ/h2/h001.t2i2YtGj2W8H-z3w7SFGvZqq-LhvhvD2y4rS0qolW-Y) It’s Congressman Brandon Gill. Working cows and driving tractors growing up made me who I am today. It taught me the value of hard work, the importance of keeping your word, and what it means to sacrifice for something bigger than yourself. Trust me, I know all the constant emails and texts can weigh on you. It wears on me too. Some days I wonder if it's worth it. But then I remember why I'm here. I didn't come to Washington because I love asking true patriots like you for money. I didn't run for Congress at 29 years old to become the youngest House Republican so I could spend my nights begging for donations. I came because my kids deserve to grow up in a better America than I grew up in — and right now, that's not guaranteed. Being a husband and a father are the two most important things in my life. Sometimes, when I'm holding my kids, I feel like I'm holding the whole world in my arms. They're everything to me. They're the wind in my sails when it comes to the mission I've committed my life and career to. And at the end of my life, I want to declare that I did all I could to leave this great country better off than it was when I grew up. I refuse to look my kids in the eye someday and tell them I gave up when it mattered most. [**That's why I'm still here. That's why I keep sending these messages. **](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6zvdjLjeZKIt1tT_uPEbTC36rMTx9_3aQXl0V7RHkScmh_R9CV_jqBYQ8UksEF5uOpSQRI9hLbPM1qu0YnoUPzkfovtvmRb1krK7SZykmNRY5bzILObOlsWPpuwAD5oO753vXFnlZG0aI443-etIIsB6PgW68Fvggr_Ww0eSlRqZygdtoRgcWn3fgUSgRJkowe-Ubty581n71sHhP0y7MXiYKxFtsLCFh6_U2Ci_2WCn0Ai5foo4j_evv8CzFj5CVEAIH25Og4Gq24KW8zTXzn8__K3zT6CfzWe_TWNXwd8R9B38Q5Ksxk4tsoAany8eJxnxQcSYNi1yZ3C3OohVvW8OUJLNg6RIKOqMqyAt17gKqjTHHYlrHgc6Xzt6bQKrYQ/4t4/BVeNr2O2Q8GWzjsfFup4lQ/h3/h001.YVACME6OUU91k7GirKHTDQxAhiDRD43snMRdBznKon0) Because nothing — I repeat — nothing is more important to me than fighting off the vicious leftist attacks against the soul of our country. The left hates you. They hate your vote. They hate MAGA for putting America First. And they will do anything — lie, cheat, steal, destroy — to ensure your children inherit a country you won't even recognize. Patriot, today I'll make the same promise to you that I've made to myself, to my wife, and to my children: As long as I live, I will continue to FIGHT to preserve the soul of our country. No force on Earth will push me to abandon my mission and calling. Not the attacks. Not the exhaustion. Not the constant pressure to give up and go home. Believe me, I'm not someone who finds it easy to ask for support. Texting and emailing you like this is the last thing I thought I'd have to do when I ran for Congress. But the country we love is on the brink of destruction, and I know in my heart that I need to fight with all that I have — even when that means swallowing my pride and asking for help. [**Please, will you take just 1 minute out of your busy schedule to help me continue my fight?**](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6zvdjLjeZKIt1tT_uPEbTC36rMTx9_3aQXl0V7RHkScmh_R9CV_jqBYQ8UksEF5uOpSQRI9hLbPM1qu0YnoUPzkfovtvmRb1krK7SZykmNRY5bzILObOlsWPpuwAD5oO753vXFnlZG0aI443-etIIsB6PgW68Fvggr_Ww0eSlRqZygdtoRgcWn3fgUSgRJkowe-Ubty581n71sHhP0y7MXiYKxFtsLCFh6_U2Ci_2WCn0Ai5foo4j_evv8CzFj5CVEAIH25Og4Gq24KW8zTXzn8__K3zT6CfzWe_TWNXwd8R9B38Q5Ksxk4tsoAany8eJ2K5oOSdCZE-lznmqSLfDyl6lXmhKkJujBTrX7xRXPjIjNesZaic1II99xH4iI62sA/4t4/BVeNr2O2Q8GWzjsfFup4lQ/h4/h001.q6NsjjnAOHT5AeQPxVWtpGStEnkPToCBGsSv6sJI4W8) This is more than a polite request. This is now a final plea for your support. Sincerely, Congressman Brandon Gill(R) TX-26

**We won every town and earned approximately 75 percent of the vote.**
To my family, our volunteers, supporters, donors, and everyone who voted, made a call, put up a sign, sent a text or talked to a neighbor: **thank you.**
But this wasn't the finish line.
**It was the starting line.**
Now we unite, expand our base, and build the grassroots team that can win in November.
And I'm asking for your help.
This campaign has always been powered by people. **[$5 matters. $25 matters.](https://substack.com/redirect/399b7742-d22d-45c6-a8fe-88e4ac159ef1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) An hour of your time matters.** Make calls. Knock on doors. Put up a sign. Forward this article. Bring a friend.
[Donate Here](https://substack.com/redirect/399b7742-d22d-45c6-a8fe-88e4ac159ef1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Anything counts--because grassroots campaigns are built one person at a time.
## Freedom Is Worth Showing Up For
At our victory celebration, I joked that I was glad I only had to prepare one speech--unlike General Dwight D. Eisenhower on the eve of D-Day.
But there was a serious point behind it.
Think about those Americans approaching the beaches of Normandy. They knew what might await them.
**And they went anyway.**
They were willing to risk everything for freedom.
We're not being asked to storm a beach.
We're being asked to give a little time, contribute what we can, talk to our neighbors--and vote.
Sometimes we simply have to **get off our asses, get everyone else off theirs, and show up.**
Because **freedom doesn 't sustain itself.**
## Connecticut Is Worth Fighting For
I'm tired of watching people leave Connecticut.
I'm tired of watching our young people graduate and leave, families wonder whether they can afford to stay, and seniors question whether they can remain in the communities they've called home for decades.
**It doesn 't have to be this way.**
I want our children to build their futures here. I want our seniors to stay. I want businesses to grow. And I want those who left to have a reason to come home.
That's why we're fighting for **federal solutions to local problems** --affordability, healthcare, energy, infrastructure, jobs and opportunity.
The primary is over.
**75 percent. Every town. The people have spoken.**
Now we need Republicans, independents, unaffiliated voters--and everyone who believes Connecticut and America can do better.
[Give $5](https://substack.com/redirect/399b7742-d22d-45c6-a8fe-88e4ac159ef1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Give an hour. Bring one person.
**Anything counts. Everyone counts. Every vote counts.**
Those who came before us sacrificed far more for freedom.
We're simply being asked to show up for it.
**Let 's unite. Let's build the team. Let's win in November.**
Connecticut is worth fighting for.
America is worth fighting for.
**Freedom is worth showing up for.**
-- **Dr. Michael Goldstein**
Republican Candidate for Congress, CT-04

# Primary Day: Thank You, Eastern Washington
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/XlbdOXuKNFV?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)
| |
Yesterday, when an Independent candidate conceded defeat, it became clear that I will face off in the general election against Carmela Conroy, an experienced campaigner. Even though I outpolled her in the primary by more than two-to-one, my vote total was below 50 percent, which means we have a hard campaign ahead of us. I will need your support to protect Eastern Washington conservative values.
I am incredibly grateful to everyone who supported our campaign in the primary election. From the volunteers who knocked doors and waved signs to the neighbors who took the time to vote, this campaign has been powered by people who believe in the future of Eastern Washington.

Thank you to everyone who put their trust in me and for helping us reach this important milestone. But we’re not slowing down now. The primary may be behind us, but the real work continues. In the months ahead, I’ll be back on the road across the Fifth District- listening to our communities, meeting neighbors, and building the momentum we need to win in November.
Thank you for standing with us. Now, let’s get to work!
---
|
---
| |
# Standing Together Through the
# Spokane Fires
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/rz8RLLD4PEZ?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)
| |

The devastating Spokane fires, and other fires across Eastern Washington, have hit our community with more property loss than any in state history. On the first day, I contacted the White House and other federal officials, and later met with the governor, mayor, Senator Maria Cantwell, and others to rush help to our area. Politics were put aside to get the job done.
My heart goes out to everyone affected by the devastating fires in the Spokane area. So many of our neighbors have been forced to evacuate, and far too many families have lost their homes and belongings. I am deeply grateful for the firefighters, first responders, law enforcement officers, volunteers, and community members who have stepped up to protect and support their neighbors during this difficult time. In times like these, Eastern Washington shows what it means to look out for one another, and I am proud to see that spirit on full display. Please continue to keep the families impacted by these fires, as well as the brave men and women fighting them, in your prayers.
---
|
---
| |
# Marching Through Hillyard
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/zoj7e7UlKkn?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)
| | I had a great time celebrating with the Hillyard community at the parade! Community parades are some of my favorite events because they bring families, neighbors, and local organizations together, and Hillyard knows how to put on a great parade! With Hi-Jinx as the theme and gold and purple filling the streets, there was plenty of energy, plenty of smiles, and just the right amount of mischief!
It was wonderful to see so many people lining the streets, waving, smiling, and enjoying the day together. I had the chance to high-five hundreds of parade goers along the route, and those moments were a highlight of the day.
Thank you to everyone who came out to celebrate and gave us such a warm welcome. I always enjoy the chance to get out into the community, visit with neighbors, and hear what’s on your minds. I’m lookin forward to being back in Hillyard soon!
---
|
---
| |
# “Super Saturday” in Spokane Valley: One Door at a Time
---
|
---
| |

Another Super Saturday is in the books! My team, our volunteers, and I spent the day knocking on doors, meeting neighbors, and having conversations with voters about the issues that matter most to their families and communities.
There is simply no substitute for talking with people face-to-face and hearing directly from the people we are working to serve. Afterall, nothing beats a personal conversation when it comes to getting folks fired up to vote!
A huge thank you to all of our volunteers who gave up their Saturday to walk neighborhoods, knock doors, and help spread our message. Your hard work and dedication continue to make this campaign possible!
---
|
---
| |
# Our Parade MVPs
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/HFrvGD6ORTG?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)
| |

I have to give a big shoutout to John and Jane, who just wrapped up their 6th parade with our campaign, driving their truck and helping us make an entrance wherever we go. And right alongside them are Steve and Nancy, celebrating their 4th parade with the team. They don’t just show up, they bring flags, patriotic music, and plenty of enthusiasm. body:
On the trail with Kailee in NY22

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/12foAHBhpBM?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
Since my last update, our campaign has kept the pressure on and kept growing. We accepted a debate invitation from the Alliance to Preserve the Finger Lakes — John Mannion's campaign told local reporters they couldn't commit to a single date across the entire August recess. We also hit the trail across Central New York, from Eldridge to Utica, and picked up strong coverage from CNY Central, Rome Sentinel, Finger Lakes Daily News, Auburn Citizen, and the Bill Keeler Show.Here is a look at what we've been doing and how you can help us keep growing. Thank you for your continued support.
-Kailee
**On the Trail Across Central New York**
---
|
---
| |
This stretch took us everywhere — cooking lunch and playing cards with our friends at Elder Choice Inc. in Eldridge (my son Conrad already wants to go back every week), celebrating National Farmers Market Week at the CNY Regional Market, and marking Polish Days at the Polish Community Club in Utica with Sen. Joseph Griffo, Mary Finegan, and Mike Gentile.Want me at your next event? Email [team@kaileebuller.com](mailto:team@kaileebuller.com).
**What Is Happening in This Race** John Mannion had three dates and a full month of recess to sit down with voters — and his campaign told voters they couldn't commit to a single one. When the Alliance to Preserve the Finger Lakes offered a nonpartisan, moderated forum, I accepted on the spot.This isn't new. Mannion has made a habit of limiting direct contact with the voters he's supposed to answer to. And on the issues, the questions keep piling up: New York's utility bills are among the highest in the nation, and New York ranks near the bottom nationally for affordable healthcare. Mannion backed climate laws projected to add thousands of dollars a year to household energy costs.If he won't debate, voters deserve to know why. Anytime, anywhere — that offer still stands.
**In the Media****CNY Central:** Coverage of New York's affordability crisis, ranking near the bottom nationally for healthcare costs, and what I'm going to do about it.
[READ THE ARTICLE](https://us.list-manage.com/QPe9xesp7gR?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)**Rome Sentinel:** Coverage of my decision to accept the debate invitation and call for additional forums across NY-22.
[READ THE ARTICLE](https://us.list-manage.com/c21M903ApBf?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)**Finger Lakes Daily News:** Reporting on the debate invitation and my commitment to give voters a direct choice on costs and accountability.
[READ THE ARTICLE](https://us.list-manage.com/A6UYvww9f0a?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)**Auburn Citizen:** Local coverage of the debate acceptance and what it means for voters across NY-22.
[READ THE ARTICLE](https://us.list-manage.com/s2eQW3HX3xq?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)**Bill Keeler Show:** A conversation on the debate challenge, affordability, and why I'm running for Congress.
[WATCH THE CLIP](https://us.list-manage.com/5XJZwNqEdSU?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)
**Help Us Reach More Voters**
Follow me @BullerForNY on [Facebook](https://us.list-manage.com/Kn5bfmB55yn?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843), [Instagram](https://us.list-manage.com/tmKhiQRwxfz?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843), and [X](https://us.list-manage.com/116ysOMS6_t?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843) to see the latest campaign updates, events, and news.
Already following me? Invite 20 friends to follow the campaign. It is one of the easiest ways to help me bring our message directly to more Central New York voters.
Our districtwide door-knocking campaign is underway. NY-22 spans five counties, and we have a lot of ground to cover.
We need volunteers to knock doors, make calls, distribute literature and help at events. No campaign experience is necessary, and our team will provide the training and materials.

name: Tea Party Patriots Action
subject: Our Founders never gave up. Neither will we.
body:
The battle for election integrity isn't over.
[](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org/1/0100019ff6c30146-fbbd865c-348f-4b51-bbfa-d722e6b0faef-000000/PSHgp9pgr-wO341PTnodPJAnYI-9QN5LSRtrUmHVl8M=452)Patriot–First, I want to say thank you. From the bottom of my heart, thank you for everything you have done over the last 2.5 years to pass the SAVE America Act. We wouldn’t be as close as we are now without you. Your work on this issue is why we can have hope that the SAVE America Act will become law.The second thing I want to make sure you know is that we will never give up on this fight. Ever. Ensuring that only _American_ citizens vote in _American_ elections is so fundamental to our system of governance and our freedom that the only option is to keep fighting. Our Founders never gave up, no matter how long it took or how hard they had to fight. They knew they were fighting for a cause greater than themselves that would outlive them. This obligation and opportunity now rests on our shoulders. Yours and mine. And we will succeed together for future generations, just as our Forefathers did for us.With that said, let’s now look at the reality of where we stand. I’ve heard from so many of you who are angry at the GOP leadership in the Senate, and I understand and agree. It’s infuriating to watch Republican leaders hesitate and sidestep, refusing to turn over every stone they can to pass citizen-only voting legislation. I get it and I am right there with you.However, I also see what’s on the horizon: actual, outspoken communists winning Democrat primaries. Take a look at what the so-called Democratic Socialists are calling for in their most recent national program proposal, “Workers Deserve More.”
> _"Establish public ownership of the largest corporations and essential industries," "abolish the Senate," "Replace the President and Supreme Court with an executive and judiciary chosen by and subordinate to Congress," "Abolish the Electoral College," "Abolish ICE," "Defund the Department of War," and build "publicly-owned social housing" with "universal rent control," all geared toward "building a new society from the ground up" to "draft a new constitution."_
Insane, right?But people who believe this are winning Democrat primaries, and could go on to take control of the U.S. House and Senate. This is unacceptable. Those beliefs belong nowhere near power in the United States of America. If they win this fall, if they take control of the House or Senate, the SAVE America Act will not just be put away. It will be torn up and lit on fire, as will all of the good that President Trump has done and is working on. If they gain ultimate control of the country, then the COVID-era mandates, lockdowns, and government control of healthcare will look like child's play. As you know, it is easy to vote your way into socialism, but not so easy to vote your way out.Therefore, we must be able to compartmentalize our anger at the Senate GOP leadership while we fight to ensure that communists do not control Congress. Setting it aside for the next few months doesn’t mean we are forgetting or that we won't return to fight the GOP leadership another day. We will fight for the SAVE America Act and everything that is good for America. Period. What it means is that we focus our energy on defeating communists in the midterm elections and work to get out the vote for liberty-loving people, so that we are able to continue pushing GOP leadership to pass the SAVE America Act and our other priorities.No one ever said any of this would be easy or that life is fair. We must keep standing for what is right, no matter what. As President Trump said, we will _Fight! Fight! Fight!_ to protect and defend our Constitution and our country.Together, we can defeat this generation of communists AND pass the SAVE America Act. Are you with me?Thank you for all you do and may God Bless America!Jenny Beth Martin[CONTRIBUTE](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Fdonate%2F/1/0100019ff6c30146-fbbd865c-348f-4b51-bbfa-d722e6b0faef-000000/XCFM2NNSFnFcVRGuJ_z-L_ukkARYiM81mKMJFrE7lto=452) _This email list is a joint venture of the following separate organizations: Tea Party Patriots Action, Inc., Tea Party Patriots Foundation, and Tea Party Patriots Citizens Fund. subject: This was never just volunteering to me. It was healing.

body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=241007%2E444211%2ENyw9Lf)
I started registering voters with City Girls Who Walk Houston back in summer 2024.
What began as me being their on-demand voter registrar turned into me actually becoming a City Girl myself (and making friendships I never would’ve had otherwise).
What most people don’t know is that when I first found this group, I was mourning the sudden loss of my mom.
So this was never just volunteering to me. It was healing. This community of supportive, inclusive, women showed up for me when I needed it most, and building these connections helped bring me back.
Fast forward to today: I have close to 100 City Girls in my Powered by People network, and I individually follow up with every single one of them for every election.
These are some of the real text conversations I’ve had with them during voting season.
**That genuine, human interaction is what actually makes a difference.**
That’s the work we do at Powered by People (and the work that works!). We build real relationships, meet people where they’re at, and show up for our communities.
I’m so proud to be both Executive Director and a volunteer with Powered by People. We have hundreds of volunteers who are doing the same work of personally staying in contact with thousands of Texans across the state to ensure they have everything they need to cast their ballot.
**But here’s the catch: organizing to build meaningful relationships costs more than impersonal outreach.** Powered by People rejects corporate PAC donations, we rely on people like you donating what they can to make our organizing possible.

Hi,

**Reminder: Jon Husted was not elected to the U.S. Senate.**

It's true. Not one person voted for him. He was appointed to the seat when JD Vance left it.

I think it's time Ohioans got a say. [**If you're with me, will you chip in $5 now to help us defeat Jon Husted and flip this seat?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137102245/639656724/-1664069836?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=email_fr_t1nd_jtk5764&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NjllNTNmNi02ODk2LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UqYSMROUDopZBB1WLnCLZT328eDIDeVYgOKoGoF_j5Q=)
