clean_body: A J6 patriot in desperate need of help I received a heartbreaking message from Tyler Tew, a J6 patriot in desperate need of help, and wanted to pass it along. Fellow Patriot, I received a heartbreaking message from Tyler Tew, a J6 patriot in desperate need of help, and wanted to pass it along. Tyler was a commercial pilot for 14 years... until Joe Biden 's TSA revoked his commercial pilot's license for "suspicion of terrorism" without even being charged with a crime. As a result of his lost pilot's salary, Tyler's family business is now in bankruptcy, and he, his wife, and their four kids are in desperate need of your support. I promised Tyler Stand in the Gap could help raise the funds he needs to get his company back on track, and Fellow Patriot, Tyler's message absolutely broke my heart, and I'd like you to read it if you have a moment: My name is Tyler Tew. I was a commercial airline pilot for 14 years. I flew for SkyWest as a Captain and then Allegiant. I graduated from Utah State with an aviation degree and built my entire life around flying. I went to Washington on January 6 after being invited by friends. After President Trump's speech, I went to the Capitol. What I saw with my own eyes did not match what the news reported. On March 26, 2021, the TSA revoked my commercial pilot 's license for "suspicion of terrorism" and being a threat to the national airspace -- before I was ever charged with a crime and before any FBI interview.I spent $40,000 in legal fees. In June 2021, Allegiant fired me. Without my W-2 income, I could no longer sustain the construction company my wife and I owned. It is now in bankruptcy. We have four children. I now work 6-7 days a week in construction just to survive. I'm hoping Stand in the Gap can help us raise $25,000 to stabilize our family and our company during this bankruptcy and help us recover from the financial destruction caused by the sudden end of my aviation career. We have nowhere else to turn. Thank you for anything you can do. -- Tyler Tew Tyler's story is why we started our Fund Their Futures fundraising program, Fellow Patriot. President Trump's pardons gave these patriots back their freedom... but that did NOT give them their lives, careers, businesses, or homes back. Tyler did everything right for decades... building a wonderful career, a small business, and a loving family. It all ended WITHOUT due process ... simply because the Far-Left wanted to punish him for supporting President Trump. Your gift today will give Tyler and his family breathing room. It'll help stabilize their company and help them keep a roof over their heads. Stand with the Gap exists specifically for moments like this... to when the legal fight is over, but the fight to survive has just begun. Too often, Stand in the Gap is the for the men and women who faced political persecution and financial ruin after January 6. We exist to share the burden and make it lighter ... and your generosity is quite literally the difference between families like Tyler's losing everything. That's why I hope you'll step forward, Fellow Patriot. Even just a few dollars could make a critical difference. Thank you so much for helping them out. Friend,
Early voting is almost here and I want to give you a direct update from the ground.
Starting now, Turning Point PAC will be shifting into higher and higher gears every week as we fund the immediate surge of ballot-chasers across America.
This week: **Arizona. Nevada. Michigan. Pennsylvania. Ohio. Indiana. Wisconsin. New Hampshire.**
We've been on calls with our teams in every one of these states this week. The energy is there. More chasers are being recruited, and trained. The infrastructure we've been building since January is ready.
[What we need now is the resources to run it at full speed](https://links.conservative-usa.com/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=97553626113d4ccabf1d023ecf3edd33&_e=-sVxTemBp-Wd9OTRDfoFK1VjpHF1-b03GAKCVsBbQQzEJgbQi4lU_NY68qPw8J95A8aLKbdXYq56n8HIpFoQ5pK_2HcFoZHMI187AIvHGq3XVoH1sYsmjdwIWrn0KDvkqDj6pzTusJ-dIOutBfoKacDGfd9_gwSXe_0KawUrsMPLeJ0gl9qzR_y6YmyG28kPXYvdOGPFFmXLYdKHPzN9Qg3rI8XWrKNx7_M4uUsB1tRkYjQqjYfPPHrnH79hrmYsiFS3lrO6Uwa8Q_i6PPlrTQz1wBqSHDYb11P0b4qEV6ir39UP3YhWoOoDmkX9dHPv0q7YyGUZdb2U83gBlOLnADIUvTrQyLcF8AmlzJgiQwMLq5GnBlOhWV5oNSFGwZ5alT3TlvoTOeIpjTxxSjq-w9dTFz_Tq1srWu95wUsVXXuum2QqRy9KMU_LsaIkAXUh) — because early voting begins in fewer than **eight weeks** and there is no recovery window if we come up short.

[BACK THE SURGE](https://links.conservative-usa.com/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=97553626113d4ccabf1d023ecf3edd33&_e=-sVxTemBp-Wd9OTRDfoFK1VjpHF1-b03GAKCVsBbQQzEJgbQi4lU_NY68qPw8J95A8aLKbdXYq56n8HIpFoQ5pK_2HcFoZHMI187AIvHGq0a5zt24bX5b4IhLUtvYKzftY3s3bPKtXwHgabQVUkhclBmuPGVVhayrR7KFeOloDBsfwSbtC4g7ymlGx7_YFSt1t-EULylA1K6wITd8TPUfCh6a5d5c8zvFtafCgkkIV7uXWYKxKQLj7NQKzcbifcZaKrclPS5C8MFHeE4DFmev59jhxX5yG8H6zmCx8zhdwb0yDfKv8sC_dG1Vq4dMSvhai0SGUzFj84xTridOVPTG6s-ZTwsL-dtcLy_VbllSuVK9Y-JyyW_erelFrXoYm_k69KjqUFcOTIMVEDWEtMQvaMurJCCTLPYnSj9m1_imcOTEIEynOiN2qWGlX2uGRvp)

Let me be direct about what this moment means.
Midterm races are decided by turnout margins that would look like rounding errors in a presidential race. A few thousand votes in a handful of swing districts in Michigan or Pennsylvania or Nevada — that's the difference between keeping the House and handing Hakeem Jeffries and his communist caucus the gavel!
Our ballot-chasers are in those districts **right now.**
But a ground operation at this scale — eight states, hundreds of chasers, sustained through eight weeks of early voting — costs real money. Every day we're underfunded is a day we're leaving doors unknocked and ballots uncollected in districts we cannot afford to lose.
I've never asked more urgently than I'm asking right now. [**Will you back the surge?**](https://links.conservative-usa.com/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=97553626113d4ccabf1d023ecf3edd33&_e=-sVxTemBp-Wd9OTRDfoFK1VjpHF1-b03GAKCVsBbQQzEJgbQi4lU_NY68qPw8J95A8aLKbdXYq56n8HIpFoQ5pK_2HcFoZHMI187AIvHGq03vCPFo3eEfvoJ0JC4x_iJKXwdx7N_Mj_mutSCXR32gjP4ZYBJ9vmULTbLKZHu3g8Y3kzg9h0342NODbZeqIgI7m3nQK_L_eKE_2c8x0gaWmY33tFts9da4nJDZfLDdWoxU2xahHlTSHHqMNJ7kVxQeQCAQF-EVZmsA6-XQgjoipcC3URk5V6IfJtG5qTks_f2KT8IKxUOmo31TQaT6Nr9tyZExbVHwDsGi3mYKBqonKHvYV4qXNp4D071br4r4NHPFIu9fe_e8gtYibh9szGurCX7kPYqTfxz3n2w5UA6HVDPCppAyvLVofeHbrFliVk_xJTk3NGBWK1MsJA9Slc3)

name: OnePA Team
subject: Big Tech billionaires did not see this coming
body:
Working people organized and moved a Digital Ad Tax through the Pennsylvania House. Now let’s take it further. | |
---
Peter, Working people are proving that Big Tech billionaires are not as powerful as they want us to believe. **When OnePA worked with our partners in the PAYBAC coalition to launch the _Tax Billionaires, Fund PA_ campaign, lawmakers in both parties resisted the idea of raising taxes on wealthy corporations. **But more than 1,500 leaders and community members joined trainings across Pennsylvania. Hundreds of our members and neighbors met directly with elected officials and demanded that they choose working people over Big Tech billionaires. **Because people organized, the Pennsylvania House passed a Digital Ad Tax that, if enacted into law, will raise up to $600 million annually by requiring companies like Amazon, TikTok, and Meta to pay taxes on the revenue they generate from targeting everyday people with advertisements online.** This first step is an important victory, but Big Tech is already using its money and political influence to keep this idea from becoming law in Pennsylvania and from spreading to other states. Corporations that make billions off of digital ads and collecting our personal data want lawmakers to believe they should be allowed to keep extracting wealth and information from our communities without contributing their fair share. **That is why state lawmakers need to hear that working people are ready to build on Pennsylvania’s progress.** [**Tell your State Senator to tax Big Tech’s digital advertising revenue and invest in our communities.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38DNVGHNeES2F9IVxdkY1DIlUGMjix-Ugazl9P8r3ofMTEKG8B5xv2lL-JCQ2tzezoSUoBdaXXHgNtngdggURP-TuDB8JIqzlJM3BuAPFk5IgsU-4qSRk4nrO7av7bt7q7yGKBi8MPIy5mlyVXlTln3JsB5OClukgn7c4KnXAVcknJ1gGtlC_TD9iWMqdSzwLMUNELfNmDoB5jkoyg-8ptJPVaQ0yiZ2MzXgtasCuIy3ps7c7nNf7toPOym6QRHi47y2HD2ntRxydj7vhncDsjHPHRC9gJ5pnJv_QkOBABDQwTZTFvJ-uoWqNUSpifbHjPrB8INdWTCdGZ7bhb1Z70t1QBEUXE2EZmXx0ygYH4Xb-67B3a2oSUyTNFASXPzerx5-5BSwQEMZUze738gnU5z/4t4/Jf-VZGCESoiPY9QJ_cMdzg/h0/h001.eCbVwaTcKKlmX4ZW_g1SeksSbYC1w0KH9CkdJMNZIp0) | | [SIGN & SEND](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38DNVGHNeES2F9IVxdkY1DIlUGMjix-Ugazl9P8r3ofMTEKG8B5xv2lL-JCQ2tzezoSUoBdaXXHgNtngdggURP-TuDB8JIqzlJM3BuAPFk5IgsU-4qSRk4nrO7av7bt7q7yGKBi8MPIy5mlyVXlTln3JsB5OClukgn7c4KnXAVcko8FtWFAYcnfqZqYQiQKmK4X9DvFsGrTMlSHrkNssj61iGWXsw02hSGCTPjCgD0NIJ8KwGGUDf_z6o2J074fqxVROcTqffZUGE4btSYrWKZ4jB5CW4_2ymnbLyRgtoA46nScT_-Juayepr3scGEIzRPqr7qFFPTtcfg7YZvnlT2L7zY7iLBWi6B2LdoQ_sAGspWPjhGlRxX76IWVM2MqdTV7SbLFzDV7q5z5W0thislF/4t4/Jf-VZGCESoiPY9QJ_cMdzg/h1/h001.bzSn2Zpu49o23KQCCO7S2tatKUFY6_kAn3UqtQvzC48)

**Every budget cycle, working families are presented with the same false choice: pay more out of our own pockets or accept cuts to the services our communities need.**
We are told there is not enough money for healthcare, food assistance, public schools, housing, transit, or the programs that help seniors remain in their homes. At the same time, the wealthiest corporations in the world keep receiving special treatment while making billions from the people who live in our communities.

Demand that Congress stop ICE’s racist immigration crackdown, now!](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_5hbu1DV_K1a9EsXVVRCLGzrPzklrJHh340Q9-MC_CqTdLw3jgZMmJTaWdOtX8I6A6di9DtnDC13hOvQR6FdoWc0yPI94s1eA2YjzivQikakyQTQYVVdjlHeUuVULFlHHNn4VSOsWM3CTCRsAIVBLnPa6-XtYxqsw-C_NiwIiYteTHKqjaUo6cc9pJ-pJc7zh15WqiUAeZZcm5WB3n6S6mr_LN95VgXgUyQ34KgD4Gt66h82zjFyN4Afuo8Iq_LPxil8YEHOb2HiRUfw82n5buNGxC-Zk4f6GpxOBaTybvQg/4t4/ezg01c1qRXq1UTD1bxr77w/h0/h001.QfdXAqy0umXHmmyUlb_gXBSxpYothtJZPDxB-S8Fhaw)** The American Civil Liberties Union and other groups obtained DHS bodycam footage as part of a lawsuit alleging that the agency is using racial profiling in its enforcement stops. clean_body: Peter, I'm going to make a prediction... When the votes are counted this November, the radical left is going to be in a state of total shock. And the political establishment is going to spend weeks trying to explain what hit them. But that only happens if Republicans like you are on record before the Midterms. That is how consequential this moment is. But here is the part the pundits won't tell you. None of that happens automatically. The Democrats are at war with the American people -- open borders, defunding ICE, eliminating voter ID, putting men in women's sports. You name it, they are on the wrong side of it. And yet they are running the most radical, well-funded Senate candidates in states across this country who are counting on Republicans to stay home and let them walk right in. I will not let that happen. And I don't think you will either. I made you a prediction at the beginning of this email. I stand by every word of it. But that prediction is built on one assumption -- that Republicans like you are engaged and ready to fight. That is where your assessment comes in. Friend, Trump and other right-wing officials are ramping up their anti-Muslim hate in the wake of Dr. Abdul El-Sayed’s win in Michigan. CNN brought Nancy Mace on to ask about her appalling tweets last week, which called _“every single Muslim holding public office in America” a “threat to both national security and our republic.”_ [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38n-G3vzkCkIlBeC0doULsR75_ELZBuZUcBiAtonY-38uP8h3Cte-M2o1Q4JRZWRtLyGU6yyEjRCBjIfvsDdy7dLgJWmbDQryBpcyFLnffoFJ70HyKKBOFCb-hcd9sZReaeQLZgzsVhT4pvcMVaeqC84c90064J5VR2utjc0igZqqVB-N47HCBmPN_xok3J6AUJthmViX0M7giL6gQv9KNVJnv57vOhadbHpADt0KFSTj1MuoiQm6exOrSwB1ahCV6_jEADiWyKrzdAvcm8evYLOG7IZ0l0hDy2wExt2g4bQ-CRpwZslZlvEcRb-pONmBahiT1h_JsePvv0QIUIYNIMPVL9-qF3r9PDP8ROORzYTZg4xDwWNO8GImuoHARy3D_SQsDK0cM2fSqp9lMbggTDE4upnah6bvz2npRotfOk-P2NcTUdU20jEssrGQMoj_1l1iBA4xflfIU8PSVzKjzsfUhJsk_2K0_LdmpZGXI4NLWm8DcF5O3FtItvsUh0jzlvuNvJe6mSqyUM12vWlta-O36eGzoqiTpyQzzoEJO3Jy7jpbBVJlL4kiu01p0325V6EUd-tu_CR_KX1ullLNx_BJUqgV3ucj_pGE9lJV523NQnVOJ43v5PhUOpv3GVA7HFjMmD7UtcGJ5GLcmuS6WF/4t4/TrYUzYMORpCk26mptsvJag/h1/h001.W5m9gwH8qYg9qNi-kbvjxLXNUdEViAHfnj5AWQLUEkw) **During her hateful diatribe on CNN, Mace specifically brought up Dearborn, Michigan** — saying that Muslim Americans in my congressional district are _“trying to push ‘our’ values out”_ and should _“go back to [their] country of origin.”_ This is classic Islamophobia, framing Muslim Americans as outsiders who aren’t really American, and claiming that only white and Christian people belong here. | Dear Friends:
Thank you so much for your continued support in last night's primary election.

I’m honored to once again receive my party’s nomination for Governor, and I appreciate the thousands of voters who took the time to write me across the spectrum.

The stakes in this election are high and I will need your help to ensure that Vermonters elect a more mainstream Legislature, focused on actually working with me to lower property taxes, make housing more affordable, reduce healthcare and energy costs, and more.

In 2024, you voted for more balance in Montpelier and it made a difference.

We were able to stop some really bad, expensive policies from moving forward, while making important progress in other areas like repealing the worst parts of Act 181 and eliminating the income tax on Military Pensions and Social Security for most Vermonters.

But there's more work to be done.

And we simply cannot afford to go back to a Supermajority or elect a governor that will double down on the policies that have led to the affordability crisis causing too many families to struggle to get by.

With your [HELP TODAY](https://us.list-manage.com/mhxCOjvPpxg?e=19cebfe173&c2id=84d1094b3a168b6495ef78aca9f3540c) and with mainstream, commonsense legislators in Montpelier, I truly believe we can set Vermont up for success and build a more prosperous and affordable state.

Sincerely,
_**Governor Phil Scott **_

subject: 14 years of DACA. The work isn't over.
body:
Fourteen years since the first DACA applications were accepted — and the most dangerous moment yet. Chip in $14. | | | Peter, **This Saturday, August 15, marks 14 years since the first DACA applications were accepted.** Immigrant youth refused to take no for an answer: we organized, we persisted, and, together, we protected tens of thousands of working people from deportation and made this country stronger. **[But as we mark these 14 years of resilience, DACA is being dismantled through a thousand calculated cuts and largely behind the scenes. United We Dream is organizing every day to stop these attacks and secure a pathway to citizenship. Please chip in $14 — one dollar for every year of DACA — to power this work.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqswjENXoYacFGtlMLXh6NAeNcXQj12YJTBzkZWY9RPYV0x_PIzjFkk24bg7AB4WGq2DaVoZwZlNGZd5hPkSXs0LZV48-1mZgPb30-__23CUPVbi7A7GZWIdGW374_wwpFnNzjEpUQ0OB4knnZ3wII91INt3jQs5XngTB55DbRbghASSsSMS8t1fSIbv5xuedNe3Ue8ZNiP-Ocydz_oqdl-8GzHkpl5WGqR2dS3BttLpSUYUzKcDy9lHHfLyifI44SCiH9lF2oVQwzjZA93hso-NnvfuRCU8GqMiHIt1CMrzHN0NKDSFtoi7mjHz0mHdRa_B8GhmyLaggqDCFPW66ytYnzDExfX76BfGchM0DBPKM24pZE-2Xvs1TrhFi0j_X-w8v7rKOEw3c46xNzm_kShA9b1ASgHdHLrZ4UPBpkZoag/4t4/5xJztgUHSUuKVD4wiZMbbA/h0/h001.wTeKw6veIL3slvzZ6V9gP4TPP74iXpmbFz91OLVgk4I)** DACA recipients were promised protection from deportation. Instead, under this administration, our coworkers, friends, and classmates are being detained and cruelly separated from their families as part of an intentional mass delegalization and mass deportation agenda that also targets TPS, refugee, and asylum protection. This is a five-alarm fire. Fourteen years is a long time to live in two-year increments. The average DACA recipient is now 31, with children, careers, and deep roots in our communities.1 Our careers, families, and the lives built over decades are not disposable. No one should have to build a life on borrowed time. **This anniversary is a reminder that we power each other. We refuse to stay silent in the face of these rising threats against our safety, rights, and futures. We keep our communities safe.** __**[Make no mistake, Peter: in all 14 years of DACA, its protections have never been under greater threat. We refuse to let DACA fade out quietly, and we refuse to watch our community be stripped of status. Immigrant youth refused to take no for an answer: we organized, we persisted, and, together, we protected tens of thousands of working people from deportation and made this country stronger. DACA recipients were promised protection from deportation. Instead, under this administration, our coworkers, friends, and classmates are being detained and cruelly separated from their families as part of an intentional mass delegalization and mass deportation agenda that also targets TPS, refugee, and asylum protection. This is a five-alarm fire. Fourteen years is a long time to live in two-year increments. The average DACA recipient is now 31, with children, careers, and deep roots in our communities.1 Our careers, families, and the lives built over decades are not disposable. No one should have to build a life on borrowed time. This anniversary is a reminder that we power each other. We refuse to stay silent in the face of these rising threats against our safety, rights, and futures. We keep our communities safe. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:

Hi – Pete Buttigieg here.
Chris is running for U.S. Senate in New Hampshire, where I've had the opportunity to join on the trail and support his campaign. I've also worked with Chris on efforts to bring infrastructure investments and economic opportunity to communities across his state.
What stands out to me is not just Chris’s ability to get things done but the way he does it – listening carefully, communicating clearly, and staying relentlessly focused on delivering results for the people he serves.
**[Democrats have no chance of taking back the majority without holding New Hampshire’s seat. If you’re with me and ready to do everything we can to get Chris Pappas elected to the Senate, chip in $5 or whatever makes sense for you today.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260812_1.joEgJN&refcode=em20260812-1&t=2&akid=8269%2E582294%2E401hzS)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260812_1.joEgJN&amount=5&refcode=em20260812-1&t=3&akid=8269%2E582294%2E401hzS)**
There is a historic dimension at stake here too. If elected, Chris would become the first out gay man ever elected to the United States Senate. That representation matters, especially at a moment when so many Americans are wondering whether there’s still room in public life to live authentically and serve effectively at the same time.
But Chris isn’t running just because his campaign could make history. He’s running to do the job – to solve problems, lower costs, strengthen communities, and represent New Hampshire with seriousness and integrity in a very divided Washington.
And the reality is that control of the Senate could come down to just a handful of races. New Hampshire is one of them.
That means millions in outside spending, relentless attacks, and a long campaign ahead. Chris is going to need a strong grassroots team behind him every step of the way.
**[So I’m asking you: Will you make a $5 contribution today to support Chris Pappas’s campaign for Senate and help build the kind of people-powered campaign it will take to win this race?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260812_1.joEgJN&refcode=em20260812-1&t=4&akid=8269%2E582294%2E401hzS)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260812_1.joEgJN&amount=5&refcode=em20260812-1&t=23&akid=8269%2E582294%2E401hzS)**
I’ve always believed that the best public service starts with listening, treating people with respect, communicating honestly, and staying focused on the work that matters most in people’s everyday lives.
That’s the kind of leadership Chris has brought to the House, and it’s exactly what he’ll bring to the Senate.
Thank you,
Pete
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**

Friend, I'm calling on Robert F. Kennedy Jr. to resign, and I hope you'll join me. Let me explain why.

As Trump's health and human services secretary, RFK Jr. is not just failing to do his job. **He's actively making health care _worse_ and putting millions of Americans at risk. **
Take the rise in measles cases: The United States had _all but eradicated_ this preventable disease decades ago. Then, RFK Jr. used his office to undermine vaccines. Now, measles cases have reached a new high. Just over halfway through 2026, we've already had more measles cases than all of 2025.
That's just one example of our HHS secretary's failed leadership. And it's exactly why I told him to his face in a Senate hearing that he ought to be fired.

| | | Hi Peter, **** Remember that USPS proposal? The one that would let the Postal Service reject ballot mail if a voter wasn’t on a new federal list? Election officials and members of the public spoke out against it. Many of you did too. Now, some good news: **two federal court orders are blocking it.** In June, 23 states and D.C. sued. A federal judge blocked the rule in every state that sued. Then yesterday, that same judge ruled in a separate case brought by voting-rights groups. This time, she blocked it **nationwide for the November election.** Two layers of protection. One for the states that sued. One for voters everywhere. Of course, Trump isn’t giving up. His administration is asking the Supreme Court to lift the first order. But even if SCOTUS agrees, the nationwide order is separate and still stands unless the administration successfully challenges that one too. So we won this round. But this is exactly why the Secretary of State race matters. **Attacks on voting rights don’t always arrive with a flashing red light.** Sometimes they’re buried in a federal rule about how the mail works, and you need someone who understands elections well enough to spot what it could actually mean for voters. I do. I’ve written election laws. I run elections. I’m an election attorney. And when Washington tries something that could interfere with people’s right to vote, I know where to look, what questions to ask, and how to push back. **That’s the experience I want to bring to the Secretary of State’s office. Peter, we brought home **_FIVE_** more victories last night across the country!
In Wisconsin, **Ismael Luna (HD-08), Christian Phelps (HD-93),** and **Trevor Jung (SD-21)** won their state legislative primaries — with Ismael now being our first challenger to oust an incumbent Democrat in a state legislature race this cycle by successfully defeating an incumbent Democrat who threatened to shoot her colleagues in the legislature.
In Vermont, **Nikhil Goyal (SD-CHIT-CT-1)** won his primary to round out a night of state legislative victories. As State Senator, he’ll work to stop residents from being priced out of once-affordable communities.
And in Minnesota, **Matt Little (MN-02)** is one step closer to DC, where he’ll embody what folks are looking for in their leaders: someone to fight back against harmful data centers, stand up to ICE, and deliver affordable healthcare.
Leaders We Deserve is backing the next generation of Democrats who are ready to step up, fight, and win. **The next era of progressive leaders is here, Peter – they just need our support to make it over the finish line.**

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

After delivering a historic upset to 20-year incumbent Rep. Doris Matsui
in the June primary, Justice Democrat Mai Vang will face this Do-Nothing
Democrat again in the November general election.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260812-mv.uSBPj9&refcode=em20260812-38158&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1002&akid=38158%2E1203867%2EhlTZLA ]Election results declaring Mai Vang and Doris Matsui are advancing to
the general election, showing Mai Vang with 65,617 votes (31.2%) and Doris
Matsui with 61,114 votes (29.1%); results also show Zachariah Wooden with
45,994 votes (21.9%)

With less than 90 days left, we need to make sure we can deliver one final
blow to the 50-year Matsui political dynasty and give CA-07 the
representation they deserve in Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260812-mv.uSBPj9&refcode=em20260812-38158&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1003&akid=38158%2E1203867%2EhlTZLA ]If you’re already with us, rush a split donation to Mai’s campaign and
Justice Democrats right now to power us to victory >>

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260812-mv.uSBPj9&refcode=em20260812-38158&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1004&akid=38158%2E1203867%2EhlTZLA ]Contribute ››

For nearly half a century, the Matsui family has controlled this
congressional seat while the district’s transit efficiency plummeted and
affordability reached a breaking point for working families — a direct
result of a corporate-first agenda that has failed the people of
Sacramento.

In recent years, immigrant families in CA-07 have also been terrorized by
Donald Trump’s gestapo, all while Matsui voted to give ICE nearly $42
billion in funding and took campaign contributions from ICE contractors.

This November, we have the power to end this destructive dynasty for good
and replace it with genuine people-first leadership.

Matsui knows her grip on power is slipping. In the primary, she dumped
$1.4 million of her own wealth into her campaign and urged her corporate
Super PAC backers to boost a MAGA Republican just to keep Mai off the
ballot.

She failed — because Mai has the community roots that corporate money
can’t just buy.

As a Sacramento City Councilmember and daughter of Hmong refugees, Mai
understands the urgency of the dueling crises of affordability and ICE
terror affecting her community.

We can make history by sending the first Hmong American to Congress,
adding a fierce new voice to the progressive bloc fighting for
affordability, Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and an end to U.S.
funding for genocide.

But to win in November, we need to make sure Mai has the resources she
needs as early as possible to fight back against whatever tricks Matsui
and her corporate donors have up their sleeves.

We beat Matsui once already this cycle. Let’s do it again on November 3rd.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260812-mv.uSBPj9&refcode=em20260812-38158&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1005&akid=38158%2E1203867%2EhlTZLA ]Will you pitch in $10 or whatever you can to Justice
Democrats and Mai’s campaign today to secure another historic win for the
working class?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260812-mv.uSBPj9&refcode=em20260812-38158&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1024&akid=38158%2E1203867%2EhlTZLA ]Contribute $10

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

| | | **Peter, we won. I am the official Democratic nominee for Governor of Wisconsin.**

And this victory was not inevitable.
Most of the political world had counted us out when we were trailing by double digits in the polls. But just like working people across our state, we didn’t give up.

subject: Faith, truth, and the next generation
body:
There’s a reason this story mattered to Charlie | | | |
---
| | | Patriot,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

Friend, I'm standing here in my office, and I have to be completely raw with you for a moment.
Two years ago, I stood in this exact same spot. I gave everything I had to this state--the state where I was born, where I served as an FBI agent and Army veteran, and where my wife Kristi and I built our lives.

body:
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

| | | |
---
| | | Friend,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

body:
We’re glad to have you with us.
#
Hi there,
**At Swing Left, our mission is to help win elections for Democrats by making it as easy as possible for anyone to have a maximum impact on competitive races that determine the balance of power in our country.**
Since 2017, our community of over one million grassroots volunteers and donors has raised over $140 million and contacted more than 50 million voters by making calls and knocking on doors in some of the closest races in the country.
And in tight races that come down to the margins, the support of the Swing Left community has consistently made the difference in securing razor-thin victories for Democrats.
[](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=swingleft-em-bnwelcome.kvkPKZ&refcode=em20260812-2427&t=1&akid=2427%2E1562180%2ErJsM1s)
_Swing Left volunteers who canvassed in Virginia’s 2025 statewide elections_
Our approach is simple but bold—be ruthlessly pragmatic about what it takes to win. That means we don’t chase longshots, we don’t invest in candidates just because they’re going viral, and we don’t try to run up the score in places where Democrats are already winning. We focus on identifying the races where we think investing grassroots time and resources can make the biggest difference between winning and losing. Not just in the 2026 midterm elections, but in the long run, to build enduring power that brings an end to the cycle-to-cycle whiplash in the balance of power.
That includes supporting Democratic candidates and powering our innovative, people-powered voter contact program, Ground Truth. Instead of using transactional scripts, Swing Left volunteers have real conversations with voters in target districts—listening first, building trust, and gaining insights that can help Democrats adjust their strategies long before election day.
Right now, we’re working full steam ahead. Helping Democrats win back power in the 2026 midterm elections is doable, and necessary. It’s a fundamental piece of the “stop Trump” strategy and the best way for us to put a check on the MAGA agenda.
**If you’re ready to take your first step as a part of the Swing Left community,[click here to make a donation to Swing Left today.](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=swingleft-em-bnwelcome.kvkPKZ&refcode=em20260812-2427&t=2&akid=2427%2E1562180%2ErJsM1s)**
Your donation will support Ground Truth in swing districts across the country, ensuring we have the resources needed to talk to voters in the places where it will make the greatest impact.
**[Donate Now](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=swingleft-em-bnwelcome.kvkPKZ&refcode=em20260812-2427&t=3&akid=2427%2E1562180%2ErJsM1s)**
**We’re excited to work together!**
The Swing Left Team

name: Roy Cooper
subject: Polls don’t win elections
body:
We cannot take this race for granted.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1016_std&source=&t=1&akid=2703%2E124072%2EYx715W)
| | | |
---
Peter,
You probably don’t keep up with the polls as closely as my team and I do, so I’ll give you a three-word recap: **They’re looking okay.**
I’m slightly ahead of my opponent, Republican Michael Whatley, which means we have a real shot at flipping North Carolina’s U.S. Senate seat blue for the first time since 2008.
However, I’m taking these polls with a grain of salt – and here’s why:
**When I ran for Governor in 2016, all of the polls showed me in the lead.** The expert predictions were in our favor. The momentum seemed to be behind us. Yet, on Election Day, our race went to a recount, and I ended up winning by just 0.22% of the vote.
And we saw it again this month in Wisconsin and Michigan, where poll after poll predicted outcomes that didn’t happen. If there’s anything I’ve learned from all of these races – anything _we all_ learned – it’s that we cannot take a single race for granted, no matter what the polls say.
**Polls don’t win elections; the hard work we do on the ground does. And Peter, none of that work is possible without grassroots supporters like you.**
[**_Today, I’m asking for your $5 donation to help our team knock on more doors, run more ads and reach more voters – especially persuadable voters or those who vote infrequently – so we can win this critical Senate race without question. Will you please chip in?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1016_std&amount=5&t=8&akid=2703%2E124072%2EYx715W)

clean_body: We cannot take this race for granted. | | | | | Peter, You probably don’t keep up with the polls as closely as my team and I do, so I’ll give you a three-word recap: They’re looking okay. I’m slightly ahead of my opponent, Republican Michael Whatley, which means we have a real shot at flipping North Carolina’s U.S. Senate seat blue for the first time since 2008. However, I’m taking these polls with a grain of salt – and here’s why: When I ran for Governor in 2016, all of the polls showed me in the lead. The expert predictions were in our favor. The momentum seemed to be behind us. Yet, on Election Day, our race went to a recount, and I ended up winning by just 0.22% of the vote. And we saw it again this month in Wisconsin and Michigan, where poll after poll predicted outcomes that didn’t happen. If there’s anything I’ve learned from all of these races – anything we all learned – it’s that we cannot take a single race for granted, no matter what the polls say. Polls don’t win elections; the hard work we do on the ground does. And Peter, none of that work is possible without grassroots supporters like you. body:
Out on the campaign trail with Carleigh’s Summer Fellows

| |
---
| | Dear David, It’s Carleigh’s husband, Eric. By this point, you probably know how committed I am to getting Carleigh elected to Congress. It’s been an absolute thrill to watch as thousands of people across NH-01 and the country have come to recognize the incredible skills, passion, strength, and creativity that I saw in Carleigh back when I asked her to prom in 2006! She is one-of-a-kind. I know you know! That’s why, with a month to go in this election, I’m doing everything I can to help her win this race. And luckily, I’m not doing it alone. Carleigh’s volunteers, Grassroots Summer fellows, and I are canvassing _all 30 days_ to talk to as many voters across the district as possible about Carleigh. [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/vi7V3y7xPon0YdHn8eOWqQ~~/AAUS1hA~/KmaD6N_5EEawtf2bAYVtOXnXtT9kVWhH2APzX8BrZYdtbMWYS7GbciNBhSVtehT7HSzrw2InKgjv19a175ksG8DNVk29sMkxK75v--7uORKsaxMy2d9UeNzR5nq_j_iMKKFhrQvOyplLFJo2PQH1Ea33fLbclkcy5dI2eigIswkQkJ15yK7z3uCMpR5c4hdUWhS89BaNujKHZPqSUhuC1l69WjmZUZb5I80hOamlmrdwpT22HuMCHuLEz7y53i_7SAkBZXTHCon06nXuC3-I5Q~~)
_Lucas, Kylie, Sophie, and I hit the doors on Monday. It was hot._ Even with 1200+ volunteers and these amazing grassroots fellows, we can’t reach everyone on the doors and phones. We need your help to make sure that on election day, everyone who walks into the voting booth knows _exactly_ who Carleigh is and what she stands for. That’s why just weeks after sending our first mailer to 60,000 voters across the district, we’re getting ready to send Mailer #2 on Saturday. **[To send it, we set a goal to raise $10,000 by Friday, David. We’ve already raised $3,855, leaving $6,145 to go. By this point, you probably know how committed I am to getting Carleigh elected to Congress. It’s been an absolute thrill to watch as thousands of people across NH-01 and the country have come to recognize the incredible skills, passion, strength, and creativity that I saw in Carleigh back when I asked her to prom in 2006! She is one-of-a-kind. I know you know! That’s why, with a month to go in this election, I’m doing everything I can to help her win this race. And luckily, I’m not doing it alone. Carleigh’s volunteers, Grassroots Summer fellows, and I are canvassing all 30 days to talk to as many voters across the district as possible about Carleigh. ~~ Lucas, Kylie, Sophie, and I hit the doors on Monday. We need your help to make sure that on election day, everyone who walks into the voting booth knows exactly who Carleigh is and what she stands for. # **Feds bust NYC fraud ring behind nearly 1,000 sham green card marriages, mostly involving Chinese nationals**
Federal prosecutors in the Southern District of New York charged 11 people with running a decade-long scheme that **[arranged roughly 1,000 fraudulent marriages,](https://substack.com/redirect/ef8398f1-addf-4721-ac90-37e9bf255f7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** mostly between Chinese nationals and U.S. citizens, charging foreign nationals up to $100,000 each for fake unions and green card applications.

* **The operation reportedly used social media ads, staged wedding ceremonies,** and prenuptial agreements requiring couples to live separately; U.S. citizen participants were paid around $30,000, with recruiters earning up to $5,000 per person brought in.

The scheme spanned several states, China and Vanuatu; all 11 defendants faced initial court appearances Wednesday.

The gloves, made by Kentucky-based Compliant Technologies, have previously been used by some jails and police departments.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d83d2120-2505-4d94-836e-2757360aef11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

A use-of-force expert said the gloves could aid takedowns and emphasized the need for strong training and policy. ICE will be required to complete special training to use the gloves in the field.

body:
Here’s why Pramila is the fighter immigrant families need in Congress.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260812-6586-footer&t=1&akid=6586%2E420207%2ETO94f3)
Why support Pramila, Peter?
Because when immigrant children are being separated from their parents, she isn’t sitting on the sidelines. **She’s fighting back.**
As Ranking Member of the House Immigration Subcommittee, Pramila has made protecting immigrant families and holding ICE accountable a central part of her work in Congress.
**She’s gone into detention centers** to meet directly with people being held by ICE, even when officials tried to stop her.
**She’s held shadow hearings** to expose what’s happening to immigrant children and families, including her series _Kidnapped and Disappeared_ of 8 hearings featuring witness testimony from affected communities and attorneys representing detained immigrants.
**And she’s introduced legislation** to hold ICE accountable and make sure detained parents have a say in what happens to their children.
That includes **_Orlin’s Law_** that would prevent ICE from detaining or deporting primary caregivers unless they pose a specific threat, the **_Dignity for Detained Immigrants Act_** that would end mandatory detention, prohibit the jailing of children, and end the use of for-profit detention centers, the **_PROTECT Immigration Act_** that would stop local police from being used to act as federal immigration agents, and the **_LIFT the BAR Act_** which would remove strict five-year waiting periods and allow lawfully present immigrants to access essential federal programs.
This isn’t abstract for Pramila. She knows what it means to build a life in this country. Pramila came to the United States from India at 16 and has spent more than two decades fighting for working families, immigrants, and communities that too often get left behind.
And right now, with the future of our immigration system and our communities on the line, we need leaders willing to stand up and fight. That’s what Pramila has **_always_** done. And in this upcoming election, we need to make sure voters know exactly what’s at stake.
[**If you believe every child deserves to be safe with their family, every person deserves due process, and our immigration system should be rooted in dignity rather than cruelty, will you chip in 3 today?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260812.EAyzVT&refcode=em20260812-6586&amount=3&t=2&akid=6586%2E420207%2ETO94f3)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260812.EAyzVT&amount=3&refcode=em20260812-6586&t=21&akid=6586%2E420207%2ETO94f3)**
Pramila isn’t just talking about progressive values, she’s putting them into action.

clean_body: Here’s why Pramila is the fighter immigrant families need in Congress. Why support Pramila, Peter? Because when immigrant children are being separated from their parents, she isn’t sitting on the sidelines. She’s fighting back. As Ranking Member of the House Immigration Subcommittee, Pramila has made protecting immigrant families and holding ICE accountable a central part of her work in Congress. She’s gone into detention centers to meet directly with people being held by ICE, even when officials tried to stop her. She’s held shadow hearings to expose what’s happening to immigrant children and families, including her series Kidnapped and Disappeared of 8 hearings featuring witness testimony from affected communities and attorneys representing detained immigrants. And she’s introduced legislation to hold ICE accountable and make sure detained parents have a say in what happens to their children. That includes Orlin’s Law that would prevent ICE from detaining or deporting primary caregivers unless they pose a specific threat, the Dignity for Detained Immigrants Act that would end mandatory detention, prohibit the jailing of children, and end the use of for-profit detention centers, the PROTECT Immigration Act that would stop local police from being used to act as federal immigration agents, and the LIFT the BAR Act which would remove strict five-year waiting periods and allow lawfully present immigrants to access essential federal programs. This isn’t abstract for Pramila. She knows what it means to build a life in this country. Pramila came to the United States from India at 16 and has spent more than two decades fighting for working families, immigrants, and communities that too often get left behind. And right now, with the future of our immigration system and our communities on the line, we need leaders willing to stand up and fight. That’s what Pramila has always done. And in this upcoming election, we need to make sure voters know exactly what’s at stake. Pramila isn’t just talking about progressive values, she’s putting them into action. Faith, truth, and the next generation| | | |
---
| | | Patriot,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

Patriot, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story...

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion.

He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back.

That's what _Communion_ is about...

And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now.

That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith.

This morning, Mike Lawler announced he had accepted **four televised debates** and called on Cait Conley to stop playing chicken and pick dates.
By lunchtime, Cait's campaign had turned down two of them:
❌ **NBC's Meet the Press** with Kristen Welker
❌ **CNN's State of the Union** with Dana Bash
Two of the biggest platforms in American politics. Two of the most respected journalists in the country. A nationally televised stage in the most-watched swing race in America.
Mike said _**_yes_**_ to both. Cait said _**_no_**_ to both.
Here is the real reason she is running.
**Cait Conley cannot actually debate the issues**. She does not know who sets the utility bills in New York. She does not know the policies she is running against. She does not even know the district she is asking to represent, because she never lived in before parachuting in to run for Congress.
That is not a candidate. That is a resume with talking points.
The same Cait Conley who went on Morning Joe in June and claimed Mike was "scared" of her. The same Cait Conley who promised she would "kick Lawler's ass" at a primary forum. Offered the chance to do exactly that in front of a national audience, she folded.
Because she knows what happens when the cameras roll and the softball questions stop.
Ballots start arriving in mailboxes in **34 days**. Voters are about to make a decision, and Cait Conley is running from every debate stage that would force her to answer for what she actually believes.

clean_body: She turned down Meet the Press AND State of the Union. | | | | | | Urgent News: This morning, Mike Lawler announced he had accepted four televised debates and called on Cait Conley to stop playing chicken and pick dates. By lunchtime, Cait's campaign had turned down two of them: ❌ NBC's Meet the Press with Kristen Welker ❌ CNN's State of the Union with Dana Bash Two of the biggest platforms in American politics. Two of the most respected journalists in the country. A nationally televised stage in the most-watched swing race in America. Mike said yes to both. Cait said no to both. Here is the real reason she is running. Cait Conley cannot actually debate the issues. She does not know who sets the utility bills in New York. She does not know the policies she is running against. She does not even know the district she is asking to represent, because she never lived in before parachuting in to run for Congress. That is not a candidate. That is a resume with talking points. The same Cait Conley who went on Morning Joe in June and claimed Mike was "scared" of her. The same Cait Conley who promised she would "kick Lawler's ass" at a primary forum. Offered the chance to do exactly that in front of a national audience, she folded. Because she knows what happens when the cameras roll and the softball questions stop. Hey Peter! This is Larry David. Surprised to hear from me? Well, I’m as surprised as you are. You think I wanted to do this? This is cutting into nap time. But I couldn’t say no to Alex Vindman. He’s running for Senate in Florida. I like that Vindman. The man is everything I’m not, which should give you some idea of what a tremendous person he is.
The guy’s a hero — a real one. He sacrificed his career to testify in front of Congress about how Trump tried to blackmail Zelensky, the President of Ukraine.
You know, I’m a nice guy. I don’t like to criticize people, but I’m willing to bet that the woman running against him wouldn’t sacrifice her career for anything. I’m also willing to bet that every vote she’ll ever cast will be because Trump wanted her to vote that way:
“Yes, Mr. President! Whatever you say, Mr. President. You’re the greatest, Mr. President. Build more monuments to yourself, Mr. President? I’ll vote for it! Gut the Affordable Care Act? I’ll vote for it! Go to war with Iran without a plan to end it? I’ll support it. Use your office to enrich yourself and your family? I won’t say a word. Do anything I can to help you distract from the Epstein files? Sure, here's some more UFO footage! Lie every second of every day? I’ll go along with it, because I’m a puppet and I don’t have a mind of my own. I’m just a little sock.”
Vindman is not a puppet. He has a moral compass that doesn’t allow him to sell out. His family immigrated from Ukraine. They had nothing. He loves this country. He loves it so much it’s almost off-putting. I love it too, but come on. Get a life, Vindman! There’s more to life than serving America.
**Now here’s the awful part...Right, you got it. Money. Alas, you can’t get elected without money for a campaign.** I get it if you don’t want to give anything. Who wants to give money to someone you don’t know? Who wants to give money to someone you know?!
[**But even if it’s a small amount, it might be worth it if you elect someone who’s different, who has a backbone, and who’s actually a good guy. And who knows — you might personally need something from your senator one day. And this I guarantee — he will respond. And if he can help you, he will. As my mother used to say, “He’s a living doll.”**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/av-em-q32026?refcode=em260812-2&amount=3&refcode2=1049_3892029_Lt-3az&akid=1049%2E3892029%2ELt-3az)

Peter, this is former Congressman and Army Veteran Max Rose.
If you’ve got a minute, let me explain VoteVets strategy this year, and why it’s going to make all the difference this November.
Last night, Navy Vet Luke Bronin won an upset primary victory against a 15-term incumbent in CT-01. VoteVets was the first organization to get involved in this race, and the biggest outside spender. We came in behind Luke because we recognized that he was an extraordinary public servant with an extraordinary record of service — but also because he fit within our wider strategy.
Look at Rebecca Bennett’s contested primary in New Jersey, Cait Conley in New York, Josh Turek in Iowa. All phenomenal public servants, but also all candidates who are breaking this old mold of left vs middle, progressive vs moderate.
Because it’s not about that. It's about whether you have new ideas. Whether you’re willing to shake up the system. Whether you will stand up and fight for what’s right. That’s the transformation we’re seeing around the country right now, and particularly within the Democratic Party.
I’ll tell you — it’s beyond exciting to be a part of an organization that is leading the charge on that. And what’s more, it’s how VoteVets is doing it. They are backing candidates like Luke, like Josh Turek, like Cait Conley and Rebecca Bennett because literally thousands and thousands of people have chipped in.
It’s not billionaire cash that’s putting millions of dollars behind their campaigns. It’s a donation of $5 here or $10 there to emails like this one that make this happen. It’s you, Peter. And a ton of other people like you.
Primary season is coming to an end, and we’ve got less than three months to win back the House and Senate. It’s crunch time. And I’m asking you for help here, to keep this wave going. Can we count on you?

$51 million committed by the GOP’s Senate Leadership Fund, ready to go at

I'm going off script today.

My team wanted me to send an update with 3 things you should know about this race. But I know these messages can get heavy, and we've been sending a lot of them. So instead, **here are three things you might not know about me:**

**1\. I married a Pulitzer Prize winner.** Connie Schultz won a Pulitzer back when she was writing columns at _The Plain Dealer_. She's the best writer in our house and the heart of our family. Anybody who's spent five minutes with her knows it. I'm a lucky guy.

**2\. I was an Eagle Scout.** I earned it as a kid in Mansfield. It was a long time ago, but this stuck: Do the work, don't cut corners, look out for your neighbors. That's not a bad way to approach public office either.

**3\. I drive a Jeep.** Built in Toledo. By union workers. The best in the business – always.

Look, I'm not a special guy. I've got a family, a Jeep, and childhood lessons I still think about. I've got a lot in common with most of the folks reading this.

And I think we need more of that in the U.S. Senate. Somebody who understands working families and good values. That's me.

But I'll be honest about where this race stands: the polls are neck and neck, and National Republicans are spending over $130 million to attack me and drown out this movement.

There's nobody fighting for Ohioans in the U.S. Senate right now, and I won't sit on the sidelines while working people get screwed over by large corporations and wealthy political donors.

name: Kailee for Congress
subject: Peter, this is still waiting
body:
I set aside a Founding Membership for you, but it has not been accepted yet.

| | | | |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
Peter,
_I checked our Founding Member list this morning, and I didn’t see your name._
I know inboxes get busy, so I wanted to make sure my invitation didn’t get buried.
This race is about giving Central New York a representative who understands working families, listens to the people who live here, and knows how to deliver real results.
I’m building this campaign from the ground up, and I want you there from the beginning.
**Will you take ten seconds to accept your Founding Membership now?**
[**ACCEPT MY FOUNDING MEMBERSHIP >>**](https://us.list-manage.com/1CQRx7KiF0l?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)
Your acceptance means you’re ready to stand with our campaign as we fight to lower costs, back law enforcement, protect family farms, and create more opportunity right here at home.
I hope I can add your name today, Peter.
Kailee
\-------------------- FORWARDED MESSAGE --------------------
From: Kailee BullerTo: Peter, dpwillis67@gmail.com

---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/1AAcEpFILCm?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)
| |
Peter, I wanted to personally thank you for joining our campaign.
I grew up in Auburn in a blue-collar family. My dad spent 41 years working as a correctional officer. My mom is a nurse who cares for Alzheimer’s patients. I worked multiple jobs to put myself through school, became the first person in my family to earn a four-year degree, and spent years paying off my student loans.
_I know what it means to work hard, do everything right, and still wonder why it keeps getting harder to get ahead._
**That is why I’m running for Congress: to lower costs, protect our communities, defend our farmers and small businesses, and make Central New York a place where our children can build their futures.**
But this campaign doesn't just belong to me. It belongs to every New Yorker who is ready to fight for something better.
_That means you, too._
Because you joined us at the very beginning, I’m inviting you to become an official FOUNDING MEMBER of Kailee Buller for Congress.
---
| [ACCEPT YOUR FOUNDING MEMBERSHIP >> ](https://us.list-manage.com/9gS1k7o5Jgh?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)
---
| |
I want you to understand the responsibility that comes along with being a Founding Member.
These will be the people we rely on the most to share opinions and keep us in touch with every little thing that goes on in Central New York. We'll need to know who needs our help and who could use a yard sign, or a sticker, or anything like that.
We'll also be keeping you in the loop with all of the exclusive campaign-only memos and polls to keep you up-to-date on any important news the campaign receives.
_You'll be our best tool for sharing important updates with your friends and family._
Can I count on you to do that, Peter?
I hope so.
[**And I hope you accept the invitation to become an OFFICIAL Founding Member of the campaign.**](https://us.list-manage.com/nd5rkbObbaR?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)
Once you do, keep an eye on your inbox for any exclusive news.
And Peter, heads up...
**This offer won’t last long. Our Founding Member invite is only going to our staunchest supporters, so make sure you sign up as soon as possible.**

---
| [YES: I ACCEPT! >> ](https://us.list-manage.com/y8DBqsVyWQa?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)
---
| |
I’m honored to have you on this team. Let’s get to work.
Kailee BullerRepublican Candidate for Congress, NY-22
[**P.S. Founding Members will be the first supporters I turn to for feedback, campaign updates, and the biggest moments in this race. Please confirm your membership by CLICKING HERE.**](https://us.list-manage.com/17HnYJsKWBI?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)

clean_body: Now the real fight begins | | | | Derek, we won. I am the official Democratic nominee for Governor of Wisconsin. And this victory was not inevitable. Most of the political world had counted us out when we were trailing by double digits in the polls. But just like working people across our state, we didn’t give up. The general election starts today, and Tom Tiffany starts it loaded. Here's the gap we're facing: 💰MAGA Tom Tiffany already raised more than $15 million, including a $10 million transfer straight from the state Republican Party. 📺 He's basically been running unopposed and has been able to run ads against Democrats for months. 📉 We just spent everything we had to win this last election. That's why the next 48 hours are so important. What we raise right now gets read by every politician and pundit in this state as a measure of whether Democrats can come together after a hard primary. | | I'm no stranger to coalition building. I got my start in the Legislature finding common ground to pass legislation that helped people. As Milwaukee County Executive, the youngest person and the first Black person to hold that office, I brought together labor, business, and community organizations to get real results. That's the job now: bringing together every part of this state to beat MAGA Tom Tiffany. Early polls already show us with a lead against him, but if we learned anything from this primary, it's that we can't always trust the polling in Wisconsin. Friend,
When I first ran for the Minneapolis School Board, I didn’t think we would win. I thought we would stand up for our community and share important concerns.
But I never imagined how many of my neighbors shared those concerns.
While I was running, I met an old woman at a public housing complex for urban native communities.
She was selling frybread – and had a little Folgers coffee can where everyone was putting in $5. After we spoke, she took $5 out, put it in my hand, and wrapped her finger around it.
She told me: “My girl, we’re so proud of you.”
**That $5 meant more to me than a giant check from someone I knew could afford it.**
I’m running for Senate to give back to the communities that have given me so much. I want to be the voice for Minnesota families in Washington. And folks know it.
This is a grassroots campaign, powered by normal Minnesota families chipping in $5 or $10 at a time.
Since our launch, our average contribution has been just $25. Some people give more, some people give less. But I am honored and humbled by every donation.

clean_body: I didn’t think we would win | | | | Friend, When I first ran for the Minneapolis School Board, I didn’t think we would win. I thought we would stand up for our community and share important concerns. But I never imagined how many of my neighbors shared those concerns. While I was running, I met an old woman at a public housing complex for urban native communities. She was selling frybread – and had a little Folgers coffee can where everyone was putting in $5. After we spoke, she took $5 out, put it in my hand, and wrapped her finger around it. She told me: “My girl, we’re so proud of you.” That $5 meant more to me than a giant check from someone I knew could afford it. I’m running for Senate to give back to the communities that have given me so much. I want to be the voice for Minnesota families in Washington. And folks know it. This is a grassroots campaign, powered by normal Minnesota families chipping in $5 or $10 at a time. Since our launch, our average contribution has been just $25. Some people give more, some people give less. But I am honored and humbled by every donation. subject: We won.
body:
Now the real fight begins
[ ](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260812-2.6ZH29x&refcode=em-20260812-2&t=1&akid=1736%2E1086043%2Ed6ApZA)
**Peter, we won. I am the official Democratic nominee for Governor of Wisconsin.**
And this victory was not inevitable.
Most of the political world had counted us out when we were trailing by double digits in the polls. But just like working people across our state, we didn’t give up.
**Well, the votes have been counted. And Wisconsin Democrats came together and won by working hard and building a real coalition.**
So let's be honest about what happens now. The general election starts today, and Tom Tiffany starts it loaded. **[These next 48 hours are critical in order to catch up to his fundraising numbers-- can you split a contribution of $10 between my campaign and Wes Moore?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260812-2.6ZH29x&refcode=em-20260812-2&t=2&akid=1736%2E1086043%2Ed6ApZA)**
**Here's the gap we're facing:**
💰MAGA Tom Tiffany already raised more than $15 million, including a $10 million transfer straight from the state Republican Party.
📺 He's basically been running unopposed and has been able to run ads against Democrats for months.
📉 We just spent everything we had to win this last election.
**That's why the next 48 hours are so important.** What we raise right now gets read by every politician and pundit in this state as a measure of whether Democrats can come together after a hard primary.
**[Please become one of the very first donors of our general election campaign and rush $10 or any amount in the next 48 hours.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260812-2.6ZH29x&refcode=em-20260812-2&t=3&akid=1736%2E1086043%2Ed6ApZA)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260812-2.6ZH29x&amount=5&refcode=em-20260812-2&t=22&akid=1736%2E1086043%2Ed6ApZA)**
**I'm no stranger to coalition building.**
I got my start in the Legislature finding common ground to pass legislation that helped people. As Milwaukee County Executive, the youngest person and the first Black person to hold that office, I brought together labor, business, and community organizations to get real results.
That's the job now: bringing together every part of this state to beat MAGA Tom Tiffany.
**Early polls already show us with a lead against him, but if we learned anything from this primary, it's that we can't always trust the polling in Wisconsin.**
**[Tom Tiffany has spent months building up his warchest to start spending against me, Peter. I need your help NOW. Can you chip in $10 or any amount split between me and Wes Moore today?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260812-2.6ZH29x&refcode=em-20260812-2&t=23&akid=1736%2E1086043%2Ed6ApZA)**
Thank you for this,
David Crowley

Democrats who fought the deployment have gone notably quiet. ★★★
DOJ Shields Private Advisers
A new Justice Department legal opinion could blunt Democratic oversight if the party retakes the House. The Office of Legal Counsel [concluded that](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckL2OnTAQhZ_GdL4yAxinoEhDt2lTogHPwmT9J8Zcsm8f8Qo55dHR0afv98fygRw47b8w0sQii89-Oa6dSg5PH1mE0xd9l5MjLmDAauN0Cwtuld-09Nj4aYDWfbqGpnZ0dhidA9ccE5pPsuOK7bpZB4NB82OFsX9icUDX8PT8GdcCdEPXjy-wnQFLbWdGNORQ9eYqHiu9OAl7ki3nUnLgypu88rk3YTpqLaK6nwpmBfN9368b5eC015zoL0ZOdL62HBXMiW55NgdX0ke-hBTMvXXgOlAw-_xHR4pZ7_wm0fW8YtEl4Pea85eWgyl4na_6kGj0bxY6RXuKeTuxir45abnWkimhLvmmU8HcnJMvN4fAYkfVmz0ih4enqf_r-z3BvwAAAP__93OU8w) executive privilege can cover the president's confidential communications with outside advisers and private attorneys, so long as they concern official decision-making. Fox reported the memo [protects those](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckL2unTAQhJ8GOiOz_DmFizR0J21KtOAFb2JjC5vjnLePKO4L3HY0mtH3_X4tL2TH5_ELPWlOaTHBLPY-KAb35J5T4vMvfeLFHheQMAqpRAsLbpnftPRYGz1Aq3ZVk24nNQ6TUqBqqyfYFRrc5I8BaBxhReratV_XDmFv96Fm_exJ1QJ0Q9dPDYydhJHaTk4oSWHVyzsazNTwmdhQ2kKIMTjOvKUmXEfttM05pqr7WcFcwVxKafbw76SSmi34CuavegWzCX-EJXx_CvFhcxLZXqEIHx5AUS46NysMeREdnknEO4t83T4KdI4pCRuySIS5vrSJhZ3jNE5VLw-P7J67On_X4VvD_wAAAP__KjKG9Q) consultations from disclosure, with its author noting presidents have always leaned on counsel beyond the executive branch. Chuck Schumer read it as fear of accountability; allies call it settled precedent. ★★★
Judge Blocks Ballot Order
A federal judge in Boston has [halted part](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0L2unDAUBOCngc7ImD9v4SIN3aZNic7ax3Cy_pNtluTtryjuC9x29GlGmj_P7QnkKOy_waOiUjYTzXacO6bo7txTKRTe-D9l8rAJLmbGJevFBrrSB7cRWqMm0UsrW1T9IudpkVLI9lA49TO3Ez6smWGx9mHNC-SDazMsAKBbUncfl70QwzSMSyfmgYsZ-4EvwFFCM_IzGajYUShksOgYU4qOKunSxby3Th21ptIMvxqxNmK9rquz8V_Aq3Q6-kas37wRq0WDGRz7e5od2ctF_S6s5tMnBsZToFIzVIqBZSw1k64UduaBHKPAXuBcrIXBgWCYJ1Mx-9JmZdJFzlGZl2bk-83v6bb-9M-PEl8BAAD__4ncjGg) of Trump's election-integrity executive order before the November midterms. Judge Indira Talwani granted a preliminary injunction barring the Postal Service from enforcing new mail-in and absentee ballot standards for any federal election this cycle. She wrote that the Constitution grants the president no specific authority over election administration, a power [reserved largely](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0L2OnTAQxfGnMZ2RGXPBW1CkcbdpU6JZPGsm8Zdsc1HePuIV0p7i_KT_r8_9Ezlw8j8x0sat7S67_bw8lRyePXJrnP7Q31I54g4KFqmMnGDHo_Ob9hkHt71gMt9moG1azfJajQEznJujw7hpdfpDa21wdvD6WBV8kVv1_I164O35U2YC0C89ryMsWsFCk1YrKjIoZnUVh51GTo0dtSPnUnLgzkcbc_VD2M7eSxP6hwArwN73Pd7YTk6-59Q5UhuPHAXYRHcTYB9RgMXLC7DTJMD2esUi0UVO3HrFzjnJL6yVnPx9OU-SYwkUKXVOXubqqMqWL392GThyF2CHurlycwjcllXMykfk8MBD_9-q7w3-BQAA___6P4rU) to states and Congress. The administration is expected to appeal to the First Circuit. Conservatives counter that ballot-integrity safeguards are common sense, and that activist judges keep shielding a mail-voting system many voters distrust.
Graham Forced Into Runoff

Appointed Sen. Darline Graham and Rep. Ralph Norman [advanced Tuesday](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0DGupDAQBNDTmAxkNwa8gYNNyGbTDVHL7oHWNtiyPbOa23_xj_DTUumVVH8f2wNZ-Nr_4Emea91iitvx2iknufOTa-XrH31y4RM30DD32vUGNgyN37RZ7KKfwLin68ibxc3T4hy47vAmWoNmxtGaGJbwawqTiwCjdWjMM0wd-9vTzgCM02iXAeZRw0xm1AtqcqisfuWIjQa-KkeqIaWck3DjUIdU9k780VquavytYFWwRmT5BBShMoR0KljvCQWrdgpWY74rRfiifi944NnXTIFRehIKjdPV1_RqRx-wJOELFaxd8TH_ZxGu86Ks3k9kufWu_fSyt4evAAAA__-BAXwa) to an Aug. 25 South Carolina Senate runoff, denying Trump's endorsed pick an outright win in the crowded special primary to fill the late Lindsey Graham's seat.

[David Crowley won the nomination by 3,000 votes](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckLGOpDAQRL8GZyC7MeALHFwy2Vx6IfLYDbTWuC2bGXb-fsVK-wObVpWeVO__fb47ipTWf25HS7XOgcO8PVfMHK98p1opfeA7F9rdDBLGVppWwez8QS-ctRPBDqDMYgRaNZlxmIwBIzY7KO0HtaiHDi78kcFLPyxajuEBD4_BCLIXTxoF0A-9njoYewkjql5OTqJxjZbPHNyBHaVKAatnzpkjHeRrx2UV0W7HkWvT_23g1sDtPM9u4c-EZ-087w3cfuZXSdVzqpTalV9YEpf2-1Z5t77wGfHdbpxWUWzIJ8VIdZwaLdfdUbxo4vitopeFrwAAAP__lKB68g), dealing a key setback to the socialist movement.

Trump-backed challenger Paula Copenhaver [prevailed after](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckLEO2yAURb8Gb0T44WAyMHTxlq4drRd4jp-KAQFOlb-v3E_oenV179H59VyfyJHT-yce5Li1NeSw7uebSo5XfnBrnH7Tt1Q-cAUFRiorR1jRd_7QOuEQ3B1Gu9mB3Dhbc5-tBTvs7hXAm3naNvV4bC-N-FDahGC1sVvwNA3srj1lRwB919N8A6MVGBq1mlGRRTGpswTsdOPUOFDzOZeSI3f27Zbre4hu7700oX8IWAQsATl-PcZI9ebzIWC5LgQsygpYRnVVcsIYZK_nUWTBM6L0uVDa8UNVcgqMCWUln8_Upc_HPwc5yVYoeaoyENWvrFTOV2SPScAyVBfKH46Rm5nFpN4HcrwAhv6_Vj8O_gYAAP__EaeK1w) an Indiana recount reversed a three-vote loss into a three-vote win, making the incumbent the seventh of eight state legislators to fall to a presidential endorsement this cycle.
